title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - Flow
description:
Job Description About Flow by ServiceNow Flow is a product and a new business unit in ServiceNow staffed by a team of 0-1 builders. We re creating Flow, an AI-native conversational experience for natural language automation and enterprise service management. Flow is built on a new tech stack with new ways of working. We challenge established practices and are defining a new product and GTM playbook for ServiceNow. Flow puts what we build in front of the largest possible audience. You ll have real ownership of the work, the freedom to move fast, and the resources of a global technology leader behind you. If you have a point of view on building and want to start from the beginning again, we want to talk to you, wherever you are. Plenty of people can ship an AI prototype this year. Few get to build a product that runs enterprise work at global scale. Join us. Job Description We are hiring a hands-on Senior Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer who serves as the technical champion for customers, guiding them from their first demo and trial to long-term success with Flow. You will demonstrate the product, answer technical questions, set up and enable Flow, and help customers build automations and integrations through AI-assisted, natural-language development. You will solve problems the product does not yet handle and translate customer needs into clear requirements that help product managers prioritize what to build next. The role combines technical implementation, customer success, and support. Ready to be the person who turns we re stuck into we re live We re looking for a hybrid problem-solver who helps trial customers and enterprise IT teams unlock the full power of Flow. You will own complex customer problems end to end, and your work will shape what Flow does next. What You Will Do Technical Solutions Work with customer IT and security teams to configure SSO and integrations with tools such as Okta, Microsoft Teams, Slack, and ServiceNow. Build, test, and launch automations with Flow s natural-language builder, connecting to tools such as Jira, Workday, Zoom, Microsoft 365, and ServiceNow. Connect document sources such as SharePoint, Google Drive, Box, Notion, and the ServiceNow knowledge base so the AI returns accurate, sourced answers. Solve complex customer requirements outside the standard product, document effective workarounds, and turn customer learnings into clear product requirements that you help refine and shepherd through delivery. Build proof-of-concept solutions and workflows for strategic evaluations. Customer Success and Adoption Guide new customers through a structured onboarding path, setting up and enabling Flow in a few hours so they can reach a live production deployment in one day. Monitor usage, conversation allowances, and automation results in Flow analytics, using the data to demonstrate value and identify new automation opportunities. Identify opportunities to expand Flow from an initial use case into a broader self-service service desk. Translate customer pain points and requests into clear product requirements, then partner with product and engineering to refine and shepherd them through delivery. Support and Reliability Own first-line triage for trial and enterprise customers, answering technical questions and escalating issues when deeper product or engineering support is needed. Be the go-to person when customers encounter API timeouts, sync errors, payment-related questions, or failed automations, and drive issues from initial diagnosis through resolution. Reproduce bugs, isolate root causes, and work directly with core engineers to resolve them. Monitor health, audit, and activity logs to identify outages or issues that prevent customers from using Flow fully. Use Flow audit and activity logs to diagnose complex customer issues, confirm what happened, and drive the issue to resolution. Qualifications 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role, such as forward deployed, solutions, or implementation engineering, in enterprise software. Hands-on experience with REST APIs, scripting, automations, and webhooks, with comfort testing them using tools such as Postman or cURL. Working knowledge of single sign-on and identity providers, including SAML, OAuth, Okta, and Entra ID. Experience with enterprise service management or collaboration tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, Slack, or Microsoft Teams. Familiarity with AI and workflow automation, including prompt design and how AI systems retrieve information from documents. Communicate clearly with stakeholders from IT directors to system administrators and security engineers. See how Flow fits into a customer s broader IT and operations strategy and ServiceNow s plans. Demonstrated ability to take ownership of customer outcomes while partnering effectively across product, engineering, support, and customer teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience with service desk offerings. Experience with AI-native or cloud-native enterprise products. Background in product-led growth or consumption-priced software. Experience building an onboarding or implementation motion from scratch; startup experience is helpful but not required.

title: QA Analyst
description:
What you'll be doing What We Need Corpay is currently looking to hire a QA Analyst with strong technical skills and solid backend experience within our Corporate Payments division. This position falls under our Corpay Cross Border line of business and is located in Chennai. In this role, you will work closely with Development and PM teams to maintain a top level of quality in software systems. You will report directly to one of our QA Managers and regularly collaborate with teams. This role combines manual testing, AI-assisted quality assurance, and test automation, with a primary focus on functional, integration, and regression testing. The successful candidate will leverage AI tools to enhance QA processes and identify opportunities to automate manual testing activities using Playwright and other modern automation practices. 
 How We Work 
As a QA Analyst, you will be expected to work 5 days in office from our Chennai location. Corpay will set you up for success by providing: Assigned workspace in Chennai office Company-issued equipment Hands-on training 
 Role Responsibilities 
The responsibilities of the role will include: Participating in story refinement sessions to help clarify requirements, identify risks, and propose clear, testable acceptance criteria. Analyzing business requirements and technical implementations to identify impacted areas and ensure appropriate test coverage across components and integrations. Designing and maintaining comprehensive QA test artifacts, including Test Strategies, Test Plans, Test Matrices, Test Scenarios, Test Cases, and Test Results documentation. Ensuring test cases provide full functional, integration, and regression coverage for new features, enhancements, and defect fixes. Executing manual and automated test cases covering functional, UI, API, integration, regression, and UAT testing. Validating end-to-end business workflows across multiple systems and services. Performing backend validation using SQL queries, API responses, and system logs as needed. Maintaining and updating regression test suites based on implemented changes. Investigating issues identified during testing or reported from production. Performing root cause analysis using logs, database queries, and system monitoring tools. Documenting defects clearly in Jira with detailed reproduction steps and supporting evidence. Working closely with developers and support teams to triage, prioritize, and resolve defects. Assisting with installation, configuration, and setup of tools and testing environments. Verifying application deployments and configuration changes across environments. Executing post-deployment validation and smoke testing to confirm system stability. Communicating testing progress, risks, and results to project stakeholders and management. Providing clear test execution reports, defect summaries, and quality metrics. Analyzing logs and system behavior to identify issues, trends, and improvement opportunities. Contributing to the continuous improvement of QA processes, tools, and test coverage. Collaborating with the team to expand automation coverage and improve testing efficiency. Continuously expanding knowledge of the business domain, applications, and backend systems. 
 Qualifications & Skills Bachelors degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience). 5+ years of experience in software quality assurance, testing complex applications and integrations. Experience working in Agile / Scrum development environments. Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, test design techniques, and defect management processes. Experience testing complex applications with multiple services, integrations, and data flows. Ability to execute SQL queries to validate data and investigate issues at the database level. Understanding of database concepts, including tables, relationships, and stored procedures. Experience testing REST / SOAP APIs using tools such as Postman or similar tools. Understanding of API request/response structures, authentication mechanisms, and error handling. Ability to analyze application logs and system behavior to troubleshoot issues. Familiarity with test automation frameworks and automated testing practices. Experience using test management and issue tracking tools such as TestRail and Jira. Familiarity with CI/CD and deployment tools such as Bitbucket, Octopus, or similar platforms. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to clearly document defects, test results, and testing progress. Ability to collaborate effectively with developers, product owners, and cross-functional teams. Ability to leverage AI tools to improve testing efficiency, including test case creation, test data generation, defect analysis, and QA documentation. Experience creating effective prompts, reusable AI skills, and workflows that support test planning, execution, automation, and quality analysis. Experience using Playwright to automate functional tests and identify opportunities to reduce manual testing effort through practical, scalable automation solutions 
 Benefits & Perks Leaves: Earned, sick, casual, national holidays, maternity, paternity, bereavement, and adoption/surrogacy leave. Medical & Insurance: Group medical coverage for self and dependents; personal accident insurance. Wellness & Health: Wellness allowance and annual health check-ups for self and family. Tech & Meals: Broadband reimbursement and meal card support. Commute & Retirement: Commuting allowance, provident fund, gratuity, voluntary provident fund, and pension. Culture & Engagement: Support for philanthropic initiatives, fun contests, and an inclusive work environment.

description:
Network Switch Platform Test Engineer (PoE & Automation) This role has been designed as Hybrid with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office. Who We Are: Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE. What You ll Do: 
 Validate networking switch platforms through functional, regression, interoperability, and reliability testing. Design and execute PoE tests covering IEEE 802.3af/at/bt behavior, power negotiation, classification, allocation, power budgets, multi-port stress, and overload scenarios. Test copper and fiber interfaces across product-supported speeds-from multi-rate and 100 Mb/s through 1G, 10G, 25G, 40G, 100G and, where applicable, higher rates up to 800G. Validate link bring-up and recovery, auto-negotiation, FEC, channelization, MTU, VLAN, and LACP. Measure throughput, latency, packet loss, and interface error behavior. Validate platform and chassis behavior, including hardware bring-up, packet path, LEDs, route-engine behavior, boot/BIOS, and memory subsystems, as applicable. Translate market, hardware, and software requirements into test plans and Python automation for new features, typically within a few days. Maintain feature test automation and integrate suites into CI/CD pipelines where applicable. Analyze failures using logs, packet captures, counters, and platform diagnostics; work with development teams to identify root causes. Collaborate across hardware, firmware, and software teams to define coverage for new features and releases. Prepare test reports, defect summaries, and release quality metrics. Explore practical AI-assisted workflows that improve engineering efficiency and test delivery. 
 
 What You ll Bring: 
 Required qualifications and skills 
 Bachelor s degree in Electronics, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or a related field. Hands-on experience testing networking products, platforms, switches, interfaces, PoE, or closely related networking systems. Relevant platform testing on adjacent networking products, such as routing or security platforms, is also applicable. Strong understanding of networking fundamentals and how networks operate. Hands-on Python test automation, including the ability to translate feature specifications into repeatable tests and adapt scripts as requirements change. This role focuses on feature test automation; deep ownership of a standalone tooling platform is not required. Demonstrated technical depth in at least one relevant area, such as PoE, interfaces/optics, or platform/chassis validation. The complementary area can be learned on the job; experience in both is an advantage. Working knowledge of Linux, shell scripting, and Git. Strong debugging and communication skills in hardware/software integrated environments. Willingness to work in a hybrid, lab-dependent environment and attend the office more than two days in a week when business or testing needs require it. 
 Good to have 
 Experience across both PoE and interface/optics validation, including PoE standards, certification workflows, and power measurement setups. Knowledge of Layer 2 and Layer 3 features such as VLAN, STP/RSTP/MSTP, LACP, QoS, IGMP, and routing basics. EVPN/EVPN-VXLAN familiarity is useful. Familiarity with pytest or unittest, API/CLI automation, log parsing, and CI/CD integration. Experience with traffic generators such as IXIA, Spirent, TRex, or equivalent tools. Experience with SNMP, NETCONF/RESTCONF, gNMI, or telemetry validation. Experience with campus topologies, interoperability testing, and enterprise endpoints such as IP phones, wireless access points, and other PoE devices. Practical use of AI-assisted engineering workflows. 
 How Success Is Measured 
 High, repeatable automation coverage for PoE, interfaces, and platform regression. Reduced manual test-cycle time and stronger release confidence. Earlier detection and clear diagnosis of platform and interoperability defects. Stable test infrastructure that supports frequent product releases. Accessibility

title: QA Tester
description:
Job Summary Implements operational goals related to software build, release, deployment, and configuration management, ensuring smooth and stable application implementation. Contributes to the development and refinement of new processes, standards, and operational plans that support efficient software delivery. Manages smaller applications implementation projects and processes, coordinating release schedules, automation improvements, and integration efforts. Works on recurring but varied deployment challenges, requiring the analysis of multiple factors, including system dependencies, infrastructure constraints, and quality assurance measures. Communicates regularly with cross-functional teams, including QA, IT operations, and product teams, ensuring alignment and seamless software delivery. May interact with external partners, vendors, or customers to support implementation efforts and troubleshoot deployment-related issues. Position Summary Functional testers at Avantor validate the systems our customers and partners use to do business with us. That means B2B ordering and account flows, e-commerce transactions, and the web services that tie them together. The work is hands-on. Read the requirement, work out what could go wrong, write the tests, run them, and raise what you find with enough detail that a developer can act on it without coming back to ask. Most testing here spans more than one system. An order placed on the web front end touches pricing, inventory, customer account data, and downstream fulfilment. Testers who can follow a transaction across those boundaries, rather than checking one screen at a time, do well in this role. Key Responsibilities Test design and execution Read requirements and user stories, then write test cases that cover the normal path, the edge cases, and the ways the feature can fail. Run functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing against web and B2B applications. Build and maintain test data that reflects real customer and account scenarios. Test on different browsers and devices where the application calls for it. Verify fixes and confirm that nothing else broke on the way. API and web services testing Test REST and SOAP services directly using tools such as Postman or SoapUI. Check request and response payloads, status codes, error handling, and data types against the contract. Validate authentication, authorisation, and session behaviour on service calls. Trace data through service layers to work out whether a defect sits in the front end, the service, or the data behind it. Write and run SQL queries to confirm what the application actually stored. Defects and communication Raise defects with clear reproduction steps, expected and actual behaviour, environment detail, and evidence attached. Work with developers through triage, retest, and closure. Report test progress, coverage, and open risk to the QA Manager. Join sprint ceremonies and raise testability concerns while a story is still being shaped. Estimate testing effort and flag risk to release dates early. Identify candidates for automation and work with the automation team to hand them over. Represent QA in requirement and design discussions with business stakeholders. Required Qualifications QA Functional Tester Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years in functional software testing. Hands-on experience testing web applications, including B2B or e-commerce systems. Working experience testing REST or SOAP services with Postman, SoapUI, or similar. Able to write SQL queries to verify data. Experience with a test management tool such as Jira, ALM, or TestRail. Writes defects that a developer can act on without a follow-up conversation. Preferred Qualifications Experience with enterprise B2B commerce platforms, for example IMCM or comparable customer-facing order and account systems. SAP exposure, particularly order-to-cash or customer master data. Familiarity with test automation, enough to read a script and know what it covers even without writing one. Experience in a regulated industry such as life sciences. Performance or accessibility testing background. ISTQB certification or equivalent.

About the Role As a Senior Software Test Automation Engineer, you will design, develop, and evolve modern test automation solutions that improve software quality, engineering velocity, and test coverage. This is a highly hands-on engineering role focused on Playwright, TypeScript, API automation, CI/CD, and AI-enabled quality engineering. You will work closely with software engineers, product teams, and QE leaders to build scalable, maintainable automation and embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle. You will also explore and apply Agentic AI, LLM-based testing, AI-assisted test generation, self-healing automation, and intelligent test analysis to modernize traditional quality engineering practices. The successful candidate is a strong software engineer who understands testing deeply and can translate emerging AI capabilities into practical, reliable QE solution Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable UI and API automation frameworks using Playwright and TypeScript. Develop robust automated tests covering functional, regression, integration, API, and end-to-end scenarios. Define and implement automation architecture, coding standards, reusable components, and testing patterns. Partner with developers and product teams to establish testability, acceptance criteria, and automation strategy early in the development lifecycle. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and enable reliable, repeatable execution. Analyze automation failures, identify root causes, and improve test reliability and maintainability. Reduce flaky tests through effective synchronization, resilient locators, test isolation, test data management, and failure diagnostics. Develop reusable automation utilities, libraries, skills, and tools that can be leveraged across teams and applications. Apply Agentic AI and LLM capabilities to areas such as automated test generation, test case optimization and coverage analysis, AI-assisted test maintece, self-healing or resilient automation, failure analysis and root-cause identification, test data generation, requirements-to-test traceability, intelligent regression selection, and LLM/AI application testing and evaluation. Explore and implement AI agents, MCP-based integrations, and AI-assisted QE workflows where they provide measurable value. Develop or contribute to evaluation strategies for AI-powered applications, including LLM response validation, hallucination detection, prompt evaluation, rubrics, golden datasets, and quality metrics. Participate in architecture and code reviews and provide technical guidance on automation best practices. Troubleshoot complex automation, environment, test-data, and integration issues. Contribute to performance, reliability, and scalability testing as needed. Monitor automation effectiveness using metrics such as coverage, execution time, stability, defect detection, and maintece effort. Mentor other engineers and promote modern automation and quality engineering practices. Continuously evaluate emerging testing technologies and AI capabilities and identify opportunities to improve QE productivity and quality. Required Qualifications Bachelors degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience. 5+ years of software test automation or quality engineering experience, with strong hands-on engineering experience. Strong hands-on experience with Playwright. Strong programming experience with TypeScript and/or JavaScript. Strong understanding of UI, API, integration, and end-to-end automation. Experience designing or contributing to test automation frameworks and architecture. Strong understanding of software development practices, Git, code reviews, debugging, and CI/CD. Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitLab. Experience with API testing and tools/frameworks such as REST, Postman, Playwright API, or equivalent. Strong understanding of test design techniques, test strategy, test coverage, and risk-based testing. Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex automation failures and identify root causes. Experience working in Agile/Scrum software development environments. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Agentic AI / AI Testing Experience Generative AI / LLM application testing AI-assisted software development or test automation AI agents / Agentic AI workflows MCP or similar agent-to-tool integration frameworks AI-generated test cases or test scripts LLM evaluation and testing Prompt engineering and prompt evaluation RAG testing and evaluation Hallucination and factuality testing Golden datasets and evaluation datasets Rubric-based evaluation AI-powered test maintece or self-healing automation AI-based failure analysis or test-result summarization Experience using tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or other AI coding/testing assistants Required Qualifications Experience with Playwright using TypeScript at enterprise scale. Experience migrating automation from Selenium to Playwright. Experience with BDD/Gherkin and translating requirements or acceptance criteria into automated tests. Experience with test management and defect tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, qTest, or equivalent. Experience building reusable internal automation libraries, tools, AI agents, or developer/QE skills. Experience with RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or LLM application architectures. Experience establishing quality metrics and automation effectiveness measures. You will design automated test suites, run them continuously against our environments, and help the team ship platform changes with confidence. 
 Key responsibilities Analyse cloud platform features and changes, then write test plans, test scenarios and test cases covering functional, integration, regression and negative paths. Support performance and scale testing with tools like Rally, and report on latency, throughput and capacity limits. Maintain test environments and test data, and keep the automation framework clean, reusable and documented. Publish test reports and quality metrics (pass rate, coverage, defect trends) to engineering and operations teams.• Work closely with platform, network and storage engineers during sprint planning, release readiness and production change validation.

Strong programming skills in Python (preferred) or Java/Go for writing test code. Hands-on experience with automation frameworks such as Pytest and playwright. Who We Are: Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today s complex world. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE. What You ll Do: 
 Validate networking switch platforms through functional, regression, interoperability, and reliability testing. Design and execute PoE tests covering IEEE 802.3af/at/bt behavior, power negotiation, classification, allocation, power budgets, multi-port stress, and overload scenarios. Test copper and fiber interfaces across product-supported speeds-from multi-rate and 100 Mb/s through 1G, 10G, 25G, 40G, 100G and, where applicable, higher rates up to 800G. Validate link bring-up and recovery, auto-negotiation, FEC, channelization, MTU, VLAN, and LACP. Measure throughput, latency, packet loss, and interface error behavior. Validate platform and chassis behavior, including hardware bring-up, packet path, LEDs, route-engine behavior, boot/BIOS, and memory subsystems, as applicable. Translate market, hardware, and software requirements into test plans and Python automation for new features, typically within a few days. Maintain feature test automation and integrate suites into CI/CD pipelines where applicable. Analyze failures using logs, packet captures, counters, and platform diagnostics; work with development teams to identify root causes. Collaborate across hardware, firmware, and software teams to define coverage for new features and releases. Prepare test reports, defect summaries, and release quality metrics. Explore practical AI-assisted workflows that improve engineering efficiency and test delivery. 
 
 What You ll Bring: 
 Required qualifications and skills 
 Bachelor s degree in Electronics, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or a related field. Hands-on experience testing networking products, platforms, switches, interfaces, PoE, or closely related networking systems. Relevant platform testing on adjacent networking products, such as routing or security platforms, is also applicable. Strong understanding of networking fundamentals and how networks operate. Hands-on Python test automation, including the ability to translate feature specifications into repeatable tests and adapt scripts as requirements change. This role focuses on feature test automation; deep ownership of a standalone tooling platform is not required. Demonstrated technical depth in at least one relevant area, such as PoE, interfaces/optics, or platform/chassis validation. The complementary area can be learned on the job; experience in both is an advantage. Working knowledge of Linux, shell scripting, and Git. Strong debugging and communication skills in hardware/software integrated environments. Willingness to work in a hybrid, lab-dependent environment and attend the office more than two days in a week when business or testing needs require it. 
 Good to have 
 Experience across both PoE and interface/optics validation, including PoE standards, certification workflows, and power measurement setups. Knowledge of Layer 2 and Layer 3 features such as VLAN, STP/RSTP/MSTP, LACP, QoS, IGMP, and routing basics. EVPN/EVPN-VXLAN familiarity is useful. Familiarity with pytest or unittest, API/CLI automation, log parsing, and CI/CD integration. Experience with traffic generators such as IXIA, Spirent, TRex, or equivalent tools. Experience with SNMP, NETCONF/RESTCONF, gNMI, or telemetry validation. Experience with campus topologies, interoperability testing, and enterprise endpoints such as IP phones, wireless access points, and other PoE devices. Practical use of AI-assisted engineering workflows.

 High, repeatable automation coverage for PoE, interfaces, and platform regression. Reduced manual test-cycle time and stronger release confidence. title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Role & responsibilities Company is hiring a GCP Infrastructure Engineer to support cloud operations, platform implementation, and day-to-day infrastructure management for a client's Google Cloud Platform environment. Working under the guidance of the GCP Infrastructure Architect, you will build, operate, and improve the landing zone, security controls, and automation that keep the platform reliable and cost-efficient. 
 Implement and maintain GCP infrastructure components VPC networking, IAM roles, org policies, and resource hierarchy in line with the approved architecture. Provision and manage cloud resources using Terraform (or equivalent IaC), following established standards and code review practices. Apply and monitor security controls, including access management, encryption, and policy enforcement. Set up and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting using Cloud Monitoring / Cloud Logging and related observability tooling. Handle L2 operational support: troubleshoot incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and escalate to the architect where needed. Execute planned changes, patching, and maintenance activities following ITIL-aligned change management processes. Collaborate with the DevOps, Data Engineering, Network Engineering, and Infra/OS team members in the offshore delivery pod. Identify cost-optimisation opportunities (rightsizing, idle resources, committed use) and support their implementation. Maintain clear technical documentation, runbooks, and SOPs for the managed services engagement. 
 Preferred candidate profile 
 45 years of experience in cloud infrastructure or operations roles, with at least 23 years of hands-on work on Google Cloud Platform. Practical experience with core GCP services: Compute Engine, VPC, Cloud IAM, Cloud Storage, GKE, Cloud Load Balancing, and Cloud DNS. Working knowledge of GCP landing zone concepts (networking, IAM, org policy, resource hierarchy). Hands-on experience with Terraform or equivalent IaC tools, and Git-based workflows. Understanding of cloud security fundamentals (IAM, service accounts, VPC firewall rules, encryption). Familiarity with monitoring/observability tools and Linux system administration. Scripting skills in Bash, Python, or similar. Exposure to hybrid/on-prem connectivity (Cloud VPN / Interconnect) is a plus. Good communication skills and willingness to work with international (Middle East) client stakeholders. Preferred Certifications Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer (strongly preferred) Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect (nice to have) ITIL Foundation (useful for the managed services context) Engagement Details Delivery location: Offshore (India-based delivery pod), with periodic coordination with the onsite Delivery/Project Manager. Team context: Reports to the GCP Infrastructure Architect; works alongside GCP DevOps, Data, Network, and Infra/OS engineers and L1 support staff. Allocation: Full-time, dedicated to the client account for the duration of the engagement. Success Metrics Infrastructure changes delivered on time, to standard, and with no security or compliance findings. Platform uptime/reliability targets met per the managed services SLA. Incidents resolved within SLA, with clear documentation and root-cause analysis. Measurable progress on automation and cost-optimisation initiatives.

Summary: 
-The Scrum Master Core Infrastructure serves as the agile delivery lead and servant-leader across the Compute OS, Storage Backup, Database Middleware, and Cloud Platform engineering towers. The role is responsible for facilitating agile ceremonies, removing delivery impediments, co-ordinating cross-tower dependencies, and embedding a culture of continuous improvement across infrastructure engineering teams in a regulated financial services environment.
-Core infrastructure delivery has distinct characteristics that separate it from software development change control windows, vendor hardware lead times, patching freeze periods, DR testing cycles, and regulatory maintenance obligations all shape sprint cadence and capacity. This role demands works within them effectively, and continuously drives the team toward greater delivery predictability and operational efficiency.
 
Roles Responsibilities: 
Agile Delivery Sprint Management
Facilitate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives across all four infrastructure towers ensuring ceremonies are purposeful, time-boxed, and produce actionable outcomes
Own and maintain the infrastructure delivery backlog in collaboration with platform owners and technical leads ensuring stories are well-defined, technically scoped, and sprint-ready with clear acceptance criteria
Track and report sprint velocity, delivery metrics, and team capacity producing transparent, accurate reporting for engineering management and programme governance forumsManage cross-tower dependencies Compute, Storage, Database, and Cloud workstreams frequently intersect on major programmes (server builds, DR tests, cloud migrations) the Scrum Master ensures these are visible, sequenced, and resolved before they impact sprint outcomes
Drive backlog refinement sessions translating infrastructure work items (server builds, patching cycles, storage migrations, DR rehearsals) into sprint-deliverable stories with measurable done criteria
Facilitate continuous improvement through structured retrospectives capturing actions, tracking follow-through, and promoting a culture of accountability across all towers
Impediment Removal Stakeholder Management
Proactively identify, escalate, and remove delivery blockers spanning procurement, vendor lead times, change approval delays, resource constraints, and cross-team dependencies
Serve as the primary delivery status contact for all four towers communicating sprint progress, risks, and dependencies clearly to programme managers, infrastructure leadership, and senior stakeholders
Co-ordinate with ITSM change management, CAB, and release management teams to align sprint deliverables with approved change windows, maintenance schedules, and freeze periods
Manage vendor, OEM, and TAC engagement timelines where they create sprint dependencies escalating when resolution SLAs are at risk and tracking through to closure
Shield sprint commitments from unplanned scope injection managing stakeholder expectations proactively when operational incidents, emergency changes, or business-critical requests compete with planned work
Support major incident and problem management co-ordination as a delivery resource when infrastructure events impact sprint workstreams or require engineering team engagement
Infrastructure-Specific Delivery Practices
Maintain awareness of infrastructure delivery constraints hardware lead times, firmware and OS patching schedules, DR testing windows, licence renewals, and end-of-life milestones and factor these into sprint planning and capacity management

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - Flow
description:
Job Description About Flow by ServiceNow Flow is a product and a new business unit in ServiceNow staffed by a team of 0-1 builders. We re creating Flow, an AI-native conversational experience for natural language automation and enterprise service management. Flow is built on a new tech stack with new ways of working. We challenge established practices and are defining a new product and GTM playbook for ServiceNow. Flow puts what we build in front of the largest possible audience. You ll have real ownership of the work, the freedom to move fast, and the resources of a global technology leader behind you. If you have a point of view on building and want to start from the beginning again, we want to talk to you, wherever you are. Plenty of people can ship an AI prototype this year. Few get to build a product that runs enterprise work at global scale. Join us. Job Description We are hiring a hands-on Senior Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer who serves as the technical champion for customers, guiding them from their first demo and trial to long-term success with Flow. You will demonstrate the product, answer technical questions, set up and enable Flow, and help customers build automations and integrations through AI-assisted, natural-language development. You will solve problems the product does not yet handle and translate customer needs into clear requirements that help product managers prioritize what to build next. The role combines technical implementation, customer success, and support. Ready to be the person who turns we re stuck into we re live We re looking for a hybrid problem-solver who helps trial customers and enterprise IT teams unlock the full power of Flow. You will own complex customer problems end to end, and your work will shape what Flow does next. What You Will Do Technical Solutions Work with customer IT and security teams to configure SSO and integrations with tools such as Okta, Microsoft Teams, Slack, and ServiceNow. Build, test, and launch automations with Flow s natural-language builder, connecting to tools such as Jira, Workday, Zoom, Microsoft 365, and ServiceNow. Connect document sources such as SharePoint, Google Drive, Box, Notion, and the ServiceNow knowledge base so the AI returns accurate, sourced answers. Solve complex customer requirements outside the standard product, document effective workarounds, and turn customer learnings into clear product requirements that you help refine and shepherd through delivery. Build proof-of-concept solutions and workflows for strategic evaluations. Customer Success and Adoption Guide new customers through a structured onboarding path, setting up and enabling Flow in a few hours so they can reach a live production deployment in one day. Monitor usage, conversation allowances, and automation results in Flow analytics, using the data to demonstrate value and identify new automation opportunities. title: Intern - Software Development
description:
About GoKwik GoKwik is building the growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, helping businesses optimise checkout, reduce RTO, enable payments, drive retention, and strengthen post-purchase engagement. With 15,000+ merchants globally and a growing presence across India, the UK, Europe, and the US, GoKwik is building AI-powered infrastructure that enables brands to grow faster and operate better. 
 Why This Role Matters We are an engineering-led technology company building and operating large-scale commerce infrastructure. Our multi-tenant platform serves multiple independent businesses, managing their catalogues, orders, inventory, pricing and customer data while handling millions of API calls every week. We are looking for a Software Development Intern who wants to work on real production systems, build scalable applications and solve engineering challenges that directly impact businesses. You will be part of an engineering team, taking ownership of well-defined tasks from development to release, with mentorship from experienced engineers. We follow an AI-first engineering approach, and you will be encouraged to use AI coding tools across development, testing and debugging while maintaining complete ownership and understanding of everything you build. 
 What Youll Own Work on live services and take engineering tasks end to end, from understanding requirements and planning to development, testing, code reviews and release. Build and extend REST APIs using Node.js and TypeScript, with appropriate input validation, error handling and pagination. Develop and improve frontend components in React and TypeScript, including tables, forms and admin console interfaces. Write SQL queries, work with relational databases and understand query performance and indexing. Develop unit and integration tests and contribute to improving application reliability. Debug production issues using logs, monitoring tools and systematic problem-solving. Use AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar tools for coding, testing, debugging and documentation. Contribute to LLM-powered features and internal tools, including prompt engineering and structured outputs. Participate in code reviews, incorporate feedback and follow engineering best practices. 
 Who You Are Pursuing or recently completed a B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong fundamentals in Data Structures, Algorithms, problem-solving and debugging. Hands-on programming experience in JavaScript/TypeScript (preferred) or another mainstream programming language. At least one end-to-end project, preferably involving a backend API or web application, that you can explain in depth. Basic understanding of SQL, including joins, filtering, aggregations and database indexes. Understanding of web fundamentals, including HTTP, REST APIs, status codes and client-server architecture. Regular experience using AI coding tools, with the ability to evaluate and validate AI-generated code. Familiarity with Git, pull requests and basic code review workflows. Strong communication skills, curiosity and a willingness to learn. 
 Why GoKwik At GoKwik, you will work on real-world engineering challenges and production systems rather than isolated projects. You will gain hands-on experience building scalable technology, working with modern engineering stacks and using AI tools as part of your development workflow, while learning directly from experienced engineers.

You will design original visual assets and bring them to life through engaging videos, animations, product walkthroughs, and digital content. Strong design fundamentals and the ability to build editable assets independently are essential; AI tools may support your creative process. Create and edit product walkthroughs, software tutorials, explainer videos, promotional content, and videos for YouTube, LinkedIn, and other digital platforms. Prepare layered artwork and vector assets for animation, and animate graphics, typography, and visual elements using After Effects or a comparable tool. Combine screen recordings, footage, original graphics, captions, voice-overs, and music into clear, polished videos with effective pacing. Design thumbnails, social media creatives, carousels, website graphics, presentations, and reusable brand assets. Adapt content for different aspect ratios and platforms while maintaining brand consistency and visual quality. Collaborate with product and marketing teams, incorporate feedback, organise editable project files, and deliver work within agreed timelines. Required Skills and Qualifications Hands-on proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop, or equivalent tools, with the ability to create original graphics from a brief Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or a comparable video editing tool. Working knowledge of Adobe After Effects or a comparable tool for motion graphics and basic animation. Ability to create and modify vector artwork, organise layers, separate visual elements, and prepare assets for animation and future revisions. A good understanding of typography, layout, colour, composition, and visual hierarchy across static and moving content. An understanding of video storytelling, pacing, keyframes, timing, and transitions, supported by basic audio editing and colour correction skills. Ability to develop the visual assets needed for a video independently, with sound judgement when using templates, stock assets, or AI-assisted tools. Preferred Skills Experience creating software tutorials, product demonstrations, or explainer videos. Familiarity with screen recording tools and the ability to present product interface clearly. Experience creating reusable illustration assets, branded motion templates, or simple infographics. Familiarity with AI-assisted tools for ideation, captioning, voice-overs, or production efficiency, supported by strong hands-on design and editing skills. A degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Multimedia, Animation, Visual Communication, or a related field is preferred, but not mandatory. We Welcome Candidates Candidates available to join immediately are preferred. Female candidates returning to work after a career break are strongly encouraged to apply. Fresh graduates and early-career professionals with a strong portfolio are welcome to apply. We value creativity, initiative, and practical skills over formal qualifications alone. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to diversity and inclusivity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status. title: Cluster Manager - Design Thinking Unit
description:
Job Purpose The User Researcher is responsible for generating deep, psychology-backed insights into user behavior, motivations, and decision-making within fintech and digital financial products. The role focuses on applying behavioral science, cognitive psychology, and quantitative/qualitative research methods to uncover latent user needs and translate them into actionable inputs for design, product, and business strategy. The role ensures user-centric, evidence-based decision-making across the organization. Duties and Responsibilities A - Minimum Required Accountabilities for This Role Conduct in-depth moderated and unmoderated user interviews using psychological frameworks (e.g., Prospect Theory, Cognitive Dissonance, System 1 2) to uncover latent motivations, emotional drivers, and behavioral barriers. Design, deploy, and analyze quantitative research studies (surveys, questionnaires, experiments) grounded in validated psychological models such as Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB), Big Five Personality Traits, and Self-Determination Theory. Synthesize qualitative and quantitative data into actionable insights by identifying underlying cognitive and behavioral patterns (e.g., loss aversion, anchoring bias, trust erosion). Translate research findings into structured outputs such as personas, mental models, journey maps, and behavioral frameworks that predict user behavior. Test UI/UX prototypes through usability and concept validation studies using tools like Figma, Maze, and UserTesting, leveraging models such as Fogg's Behavior Model. Own end-to-end research execution including study design, participant recruitment, psychometric segmentation, data analysis, and insight storytelling. B - Additional Accountabilities Pertaining to the Role Partner closely with design, product, and business teams to convert behavioral insights into bias-aware recommendations, nudges, and experience improvements. Monitor fintech and behavioral science trends (e.g., hyperbolic discounting, decision fatigue) through diary studies, ethnographic research, and secondary analysis. Support business KPIs such as conversion, engagement, retention, and trust through evidence-backed research inputs. Contribute to the development of internal research standards, methodologies, and best practices. Key Decisions / Dimensions Selection of appropriate research methodologies, tools, and psychological frameworks for specific business problems. Prioritization of research initiatives based on business impact and user needs. Major Challenges Translating complex psychological theories into clear, actionable recommendations for cross-functional stakeholders. Balancing qualitative depth with quantitative scale in fast-paced product environments. Driving adoption of research insights in business and product decision-making. Required Qualifications and Experience a) Qualifications Master's degree in Behavioral Design, Interaction Design, Human Psychology, Cognitive Science, or related discipline b) Work Experience 5+ years of hands-on experience in qualitative and quantitative user research within consumer tech, fintech, or digital product environments. Proven application of psychological and behavioral science theories portfolio must demonstrate this expertise. Strong design background with proficiency in UX/UI principles and prototyping tools (Figma, Sketch). Expertise in research tools such as UserTesting, Qualtrics, Dovetail, Miro, and Maze. Demonstrated ability to build insights through behavioral and cognitive lenses with measurable cross-functional impact. Excellent communication and storytelling skills to simplify complex theories for diverse stakeholders. Strong analytical mindset with experience in psychometrics and statistical analysis. High ownership, self-motivation, and ability to operate independently in a high-performance environment. Bonus: Prior fintech research experience (e.g., behavioral economics in payments, lending, investments). Certifications in behavioral science or insights (e.g., HBR Behavioral Insights).

title: UI/UX Lead
description:
Job Details 
 Position Title: UI/UX Lead Reports To: VP Product Location: Jaipur/Gurugram Job Type: Full Time Legal Entity: Vconnex Pvt Ltd Qualifications: Any Graduations (BCA, MCA, Btech) Experience Required: 10+ years 
 
 Job Summary 
 The UI/UX Lead is responsible for leading CIMET's design function across all consumer-facing and internal product experiences. The role will establish design standards, drive user-centric product decisions, own the design system, mentor and develop the design team, and ensure design quality across multiple business verticals. As a player-coach, the UI/UX Lead will combine strategic leadership with hands-on design execution, helping CIMET deliver seamless, conversion-focused, and trusted customer experiences across Energy, Telecom, Insurance, and Finance products 
 
 Key Accountabilities 
 
 Design Leadership Team Development 
 Lead, mentor, and develop the design team across multiple product verticals. Establish design review rituals, quality standards, and performance expectations. Build capability within the design function through coaching, feedback, and hiring. Represent design within leadership discussions and influence product direction. 
 
 Design System Standards 
 Own and evolve CIMET's design system, component library, interaction patterns, accessibility standards, and design governance. Drive consistency across products and white-label experiences. Define design tokens and collaborate with Engineering to ensure system adoption within production code. Manage design system lifecycle, versioning, and deprecation processes. 
 
 User Journey Design 
 Own and optimize end-to-end customer journeys including comparison, eligibility, plan selection, checkout/application, onboarding, and post-conversion experiences. Design complex, high-stakes user experiences involving financial and comparison products. Lead information architecture decisions and ensure seamless experiences across product verticals. Maintain consistency and usability throughout the customer lifecycle. 
 
 User Research Evidence-Based Design 
 Establish user research as a core part of the product development lifecycle. Conduct usability testing, journey mapping, concept validation, and customer insight analysis. Translate user feedback and behavioural data into design improvements. Advocate for design decisions grounded in evidence and measurable outcomes. 
 
 Product Stakeholder Collaboration 
 Partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Analytics, and Leadership teams. Define and improve collaboration models between Product and Design. Facilitate structured design briefs and review processes. Influence product strategy through a deep understanding of users and business goals. 
 
 Your Skills and Experience 
 
 Essential Requirements 
 15+ years of product design experience in consumer technology environments. Minimum 3 years leading and managing design teams. Experience owning transactional or high-stakes consumer journeys such as Financial Services, Insurance, Utilities, E-commerce Checkout, Marketplace, or similar domains. Proven experience building and scaling production-ready design systems. Strong experience in conversion-focused UX and customer journey optimization. Expert-level proficiency in Figma includes component architecture, prototyping, and developer handoff. Strong information architecture and interaction design skills. Mobile-first and responsive design expertise. Experience with WCAG accessibility standards. Ability to interpret analytics, funnel metrics, heatmaps, and usability data to drive product improvements. 
 
 Leadership Capabilities 
 Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Ability to challenge assumptions and influence product direction. Experience collaborating closely with Engineering and Product teams. Proven ability to develop design talent and build high-performing teams. Passion for balancing design quality with measurable business outcomes. 
 
 Preferred 
 Experience in FinTech, Insurtech, Telecom, Marketplace, Comparison Platforms, E-commerce, or other consumer-tech product companies. Exposure to AI-assisted design workflows and generative design tools. Experience working across multiple product lines or business verticals. Familiarity with Maze, User Testing, Lookback, or similar research platforms. Understanding of frontend constraints, design tokens, and design system implementation. 
 
 Challenges of the Position 
 Rapid Growth CIMET will grow massively over the next 2 years, we need to build and onboard a team of high-performing people to enable the planned growth to reach fruition. Systems CIMET is in the growth phase of the expansion, where systems, processes and policies are being developed and implemented. This means there will be constant changes occurring and you will need to be agile in your approach to changing business priorities.

 Job Summary We are looking for a skilled Architectural Designer / Revit Draftsman with 4–8 years of experience in residential architectural design and drafting, preferably handling US-based single-family home projects. The ideal candidate should have strong proficiency in Autodesk Revit, a sound understanding of architectural drawings, and the ability to prepare detailed construction and permit drawing sets in accordance with US building standards.

Develop floor plans, elevations, sections, roof plans, and site plans using Autodesk Revit. Prepare permit-ready drawing sets for new construction, additions, remodels, and renovations. Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills. Good communication and coordination skills. Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Familiarity with California residential building codes and permitting processes. Knowledge of AutoCAD in addition to Revit. Experience coordinating with structural engineers and other consultants. title: Project Manager-Interior Design & Execution
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 1. Project Planning & Scheduling Prepare project execution plans, timelines, and work schedules for each project. Break down projects into activities, milestones, and deadlines. Coordinate civil, electrical, plumbing, flooring, false ceiling, painting, carpentry, modular kitchen, glass, metal, and other interior works. Monitor daily progress and ensure projects are completed within committed timelines. Identify potential delays and implement corrective measures. 2. Site Execution & Supervision Conduct regular site visits and supervise day-to-day execution activities. Ensure work is carried out according to approved drawings, BOQs, specifications, and design intent. Coordinate site supervisors, contractors, labour teams, and subcontractors. Verify site measurements, levels, dimensions, and execution details. Resolve site-related technical issues and coordinate with the design team for drawing clarifications. 3. Vendor & Contractor Management Coordinate with vendors, suppliers, contractors, and material suppliers. Obtain quotations, compare rates, negotiate pricing, and support vendor finalisation. Ensure timely procurement and delivery of materials to prevent work stoppages. Track vendor commitments, workmanship, material quality, and pending payments. Maintain effective vendor relationships while controlling project costs. 4. Budget & Cost Control Understand and monitor the project BOQ, approved estimate, and execution budget. Track material consumption, labour costs, wastage, and additional expenses. Prevent unnecessary purchases, rework, and cost overruns. Identify deviations from the approved BOQ and obtain approval for additional work before execution. Coordinate with the accounts team for vendor bills, work completion verification, and payment planning. Monitor project profitability and report cost variations to management. 5. Design & Client Coordination Coordinate with the interior design and 3D visualisation teams to ensure design intent is implemented accurately. Review working drawings, electrical layouts, ceiling plans, furniture details, and other execution drawings before work begins. Communicate project progress, challenges, and important decisions to clients. Conduct site meetings and maintain clear records of client instructions and approvals. Manage client expectations and ensure changes are documented and approved before implementation. 6. Quality Control & Safety Conduct quality inspections at every major stage of execution. Ensure materials and workmanship meet approved specifications and company standards. Check finishing quality, alignment, dimensions, joints, paint finish, fixtures, and installation details. Identify defects, prepare snag lists, and ensure rectification before handover. Maintain site cleanliness, safe working practices, and proper material storage. 7. Reporting & Documentation Submit daily or weekly site progress reports to management. Maintain project schedules, BOQ updates, material records, measurement sheets, and work completion reports. Track project milestones, pending decisions, procurement status, and site issues. Maintain records of approved drawings, variations, client approvals, and contractor commitments. Escalate critical delays, budget deviations, quality issues, and resource requirements promptly. 8. Project Completion & Handover Ensure all contracted work is completed as per scope and approved specifications. Conduct final inspections and coordinate snag rectification. Verify final measurements, material usage, and additional work executed. Coordinate preparation of final bills, warranties, manuals, and handover documentation. Ensure a smooth client handover and coordinate resolution of post-handover defects during the applicable service period. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) On-time project completion. Project execution within the approved budget. Quality of workmanship and reduction in rework. Timely procurement and efficient vendor coordination. Client satisfaction and timely resolution of complaints. Accuracy of project reporting and BOQ tracking. Timely closure of snags and project handover. Effective utilisation of labour, materials, and site resources. Reporting Structure The Project Manager will report directly to the management and coordinate with the design team, site supervisors, vendors, contractors, accounts team, and clients. 
 Preferred candidate profile 
 Educational Qualification Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Interior Design, Architecture, or a related field. Candidates with relevant interior execution experience will be preferred over candidates with only academic design experience. Experience 47 years of overall experience in interior design execution, project management, or turnkey interior projects. At least 3 years of hands-on experience managing interior project sites independently. Experience in residential interiors, offices, retail spaces, or commercial fit-outs. Experience handling multiple projects or multiple site teams simultaneously will be an advantage. Technical Skills Good understanding of civil work, flooring, false ceilings, painting, electrical, plumbing, carpentry, modular kitchens, furniture, and finishing works. Ability to read and interpret AutoCAD drawings, working drawings, layouts, sections, and detailed furniture drawings. Strong understanding of BOQs, quantity estimation, material specifications, measurement sheets, and project costing. Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office, and project planning and reporting tools. Knowledge of AutoCAD is essential; knowledge of SketchUp or other interior design software is an advantage. Project Management Skills Ability to prepare project schedules and track daily progress against milestones. Experience in vendor selection, rate negotiation, material procurement, and contractor management. Ability to control project costs, reduce wastage, and prevent unnecessary rework. title: Architectural Designer
description:
Project Type: US Residential Single-Family Homes
 Experience: 4-8 Years
 Education: Bachelors Degree in Architecture
 Software: Autodesk Revit (Mandatory)
 Location: Hyderabad/Bgumpet
 Employment Type: Full-Time 
 Job Summary We are looking for a skilled Architectural Designer / Revit Draftsman with 4–8 years of experience in residential architectural design and drafting, preferably handling US-based single-family home projects. The ideal candidate should have strong proficiency in Autodesk Revit, a sound understanding of architectural drawings, and the ability to prepare detailed construction and permit drawing sets in accordance with US building standards. 
 Key Responsibilities Prepare architectural drawings and detailed construction documentation for US single-family residential projects. Develop floor plans, elevations, sections, roof plans, and site plans using Autodesk Revit. Prepare permit-ready drawing sets for new construction, additions, remodels, and renovations. Convert sketches, markups, and conceptual designs into accurate architectural drawings. Develop existing and proposed floor plans based on site measurements and client requirements. Coordinate architectural drawings with structural, mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) consultants. Incorporate client feedback, design revisions, and city plan-check comments into drawing sets. Ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality of drawings throughout the project lifecycle. Collaborate with project managers, architects, and engineering teams to meet project deadlines. Maintain organized project files, Revit models, and drawing documentation. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree in Architecture (B.Arch) is mandatory. 4–8 years of relevant experience in architectural design and drafting. Strong proficiency in Autodesk Revit is mandatory. Experience in US residential projects, particularly single-family homes, is highly preferred. Good understanding of US residential construction practices and architectural drafting standards. Knowledge of construction drawings, detailing, dimensions, and building materials. Familiarity with US building codes, zoning regulations, and permit documentation. Ability to interpret architectural sketches, redlines, and design specifications. Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills. Good communication and coordination skills. Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously. 
 Preferred Qualifications Experience with residential additions, ADUs, garage conversions, remodels, and new home construction. Familiarity with California residential building codes and permitting processes. Knowledge of AutoCAD in addition to Revit. Experience coordinating with structural engineers and other consultants. Familiarity with BIM workflows and Revit family creation. 
 What We Are Looking For A detail-oriented professional who can independently handle architectural drafting and documentation for US single-family residential projects, deliver high-quality Revit models, and effectively coordinate with internal teams and external consultants.

Key Skills: Architectural design,REVIT architecture,Architecture,REVIT,Design,AutoCAD

title: Senior Product Manager, Data Platform
description:
Job Summary Guidewire builds the software that property and casualty (PC) insurers use to care for customers in a crisis, whether a natural disaster or an accident. The Data Platform team builds the secure, scalable data foundation behind Guidewires analytics, data science and data management applications. It is built into our product portfolio, and both internal development teams and customers rely on it to put data to work. You will own the data access and integration experience of the platform: how data gets in, how it is accessed, and how consuming teams integrate with it. You will be the decision-maker for your area and work with engineers, architects and UX to take products from concept to launch. You will also shape how AI-driven capabilities, such as agentic experiences and MCP-based integrations, make data access smarter and more self-service. Job Description Own the product Act as the authoritative product owner for one or more data access and integration areas, leading discussions to a clear recommendation or decision. Build a shared vision and consensus on priorities across the company. Define and analyze the metrics that show whether your products succeed. Define and ship Guide one or more engineering teams from ideation through launch of data ingestion, access and integration capabilities. Write product requirements from a user and functional perspective, with scope, supported patterns and acceptance criteria that engineering can build against. Define and ship AI-driven capabilities (for example, agentic experiences and MCP-based integrations) that make data access more self-service. Run feature-level design sessions with engineers, architects and UX. Align across teams Own the product interface between the Data Platform and the teams that consume it, driving agreement on integration contracts, dependencies and scope. Drive initiatives to closure with limited supervision: set direction, communicate status and risks early, and follow through on commitments. Partner with customers and the field Develop a deep understanding of customer needs and challenges so they adopt our data access products successfully. Be the product expert for customers, QA, support and sales on our cloud-native data infrastructure. Triage, prioritize and respond to customer issues and escalations. What you bring (required) 5+ years of product management experience. 5+ years working with the technical architecture and security of cloud solutions. Working fluency with distributed data systems (data replication and CDC, streaming such as Kafka, table formats such as Apache Iceberg, data cataloging, microservices, AWS data infrastructure), enough to reason about design trade-offs and write correct requirements. A solid grasp of the AWS credential and access model (IAM roles, policies, principals, scoped and temporary credentials) to reason about secure data access. Ability to learn unfamiliar technical concepts quickly and turn them into requirements at the persona and functional level, not implementation detail. Comfort using AI tools across the development lifecycle, including spec-driven development and AI-assisted requirements, design and delivery. A record of driving complex initiatives to closure with limited supervision. Clear written and verbal communication that keeps stakeholders across multiple teams aligned. Ownership, resilience and comfort with ambiguity. Strongly preferred Experience defining and shipping AI product features, such as agentic AI, LLM-powered capabilities or MCP server integrations. Understanding of data federation, including querying and accessing data across sources without moving it. Experience with data ingestion, cataloging, integration and enrichment, and how they connect to end-user analytics applications. Experience at a B2B SaaS company. Software engineering experience.

description:
Required Qualifications Bachelor's or master's degree in information systems, Data Science, Computer Science, Life Sciences, or a related discipline. Seven or more years of relevant experience, including at least three years directly defining or managing data, analytics, platform, scientific-informatics or AI-enabled products. Demonstrated experience translating business outcomes and use cases into roadmaps, strategic backlogs, product definitions, and phased delivery plans. Experience facilitating prioritization, managing cross-team dependencies, and coordinating stakeholders across business, architecture, governance, platform, and engineering teams. Understanding of domain-oriented data products, data contracts, canonical models, metadata, governance, and medallion architecture. Working knowledge of scientific and regulated-data principles, including provenance, traceability, FAIR practices, privacy by design and, where applicable, GxP and ALCOA+ expectations. Strong facilitation, communication, executive storytelling, negotiation, and Agile/product delivery skills. Preferred Qualifications Broader experience across multiple pharmaceutical or biotechnology RD functions and data domains. Experience with scientific, clinical, operational, safety or regulatory data products and AI-enabled RD use cases. Experience with federated or data-mesh operating models, domain blueprints, product certification and enterprise governance. Familiarity with Databricks, Unity Catalog, Jira or Azure DevOps, metadata and catalog platforms, product analytics, SQL or business-intelligence tools. Experience defining responsible-AI, model-evaluation, data-suitability or AI-observability requirements in regulated or high-impact settings. Experience incorporating privacy, security, cross-border data-use constraints and purpose-based access requirements into global data-product planning. Experience leading global, geographically distributed teams and organizational change. Purpose and Scope The RD Domain Data Product Manager develops recommendations for and activates the approved data product strategy for an assigned biopharma RD domain. Working with the Data Domain Owner and scientific, clinical, data, architecture, governance, engineering and platform stakeholders, the role identifies high-value user and business needs and translates them into a coherent portfolio of reusable data products. It establishes proposed product boundaries, value hypotheses and roadmaps, incorporates quality and governance expectations defined with data stewards and relevant specialists, and recommends investment priorities for approval by the Data Domain Owner. The role owns domain-level product discovery, portfolio prioritization recommendations, product mobilization and cross-product dependency management within approved priorities and investment guardrails. It coordinates validation of scientific relevance and consumer needs with scientific and clinical stakeholders; technical feasibility and interoperability with architecture, modeling, engineering and platform teams; and quality, governance, privacy and analytical and AI-use readiness with data stewards, governance specialists and relevant privacy and technical authorities. Once a product is approved and sufficiently defined, detailed delivery and lifecycle accountability transitions to a designated Data Product Owner. The Domain Data Product Manager retains responsibility for domain-wide portfolio coherence, cross-product dependencies, portfolio-level value tracking, identification of reuse opportunities and alignment with the approved domain strategy. Responsibilities and Accountabilities Partner with the Data Domain Owner to translate domain outcomes, use cases, investment priorities, and OKRs into a clear domain data product vision, roadmap, and strategic backlog. Establish and continuously refine a prioritized domain backlog covering candidate data products, domain blueprint work, source dependencies, data contracts, governance needs, and enabling platform capabilities. Work with the Domain Data Architect and Domain Data Modelers to develop and maintain the domain blueprint, product decomposition, canonical/semantic modeling priorities, interoperability needs, and reusable architecture patterns. Facilitate use-case decomposition into required data products, MVP boundaries, capabilities, sequencing, business value hypotheses, and measurable success criteria. Coordinate demand intake, opportunity evaluation, value/effort prioritization, dependency mapping, and escalation of cross-domain or platform constraints; make trade-offs transparent to the Domain Owner. Maintain a consolidated view of domain initiatives, product status, backlog readiness, delivery milestones, capacity assumptions, risks, decisions, and strategic dependencies. Engage the Foundation Data Platform team to align on source availability, ingestion needs, technical readiness, shared standards, and planned capability changes without taking ownership of platform engineering. Partner with Data Governance Specialists and stewards to embed ownership, business glossary, metadata, data quality, lineage, contract, certification, privacy, and AI-readiness.
