title: Group Product Manager
description:
Role: Group Product Manager Location: Peenya, Bengaluru Reporting To: SVP Marketing Product Management Experience: 8-12 years | Ophthalmology / MedTech / Medical Devices 
 About Remidio Remidio is a Bengaluru-headquartered ophthalmic med-tech company developing AI-powered retinal imaging and eye-screening solutions. Our products combine advanced imaging technology, artificial intelligence, and cloud-based platforms to make quality eye care more accessible. With a growing global presence, Remidio is transforming how eye diseases are detected, monitored, and managed across hospitals, clinics, and community screening programs. We are a fast-scaling, innovation-driven organisation where ownership, speed, customer-centricity, and execution define how we work. 
 The Opportunity We are looking for a strategic and commercially driven Group Product Manager to lead Remidios ophthalmic product portfolio and drive its next phase of growth.This role will own the complete product lifecycle - from market intelligence, opportunity identification, product strategy, and roadmap development to product launches, market adoption, and portfolio performance. You will work closely with Engineering, AI/Software, Clinical, Sales, Marketing, and Leadership teams to ensure that Remidio builds products that solve meaningful clinical problems, differentiate in the market, and deliver sustainable business growth. 
 What You Will Own 1. Product Strategy Portfolio Leadership Own the overall product strategy and portfolio direction across Remidios ophthalmic imaging, diagnostic, and AI-powered solutions. Define product vision, positioning, value propositions, and long-term portfolio priorities aligned with business objectives. Identify opportunities for new products, product extensions, upgrades, and adjacent market segments. Evaluate portfolio gaps, product differentiation, competitive positioning, and opportunities for innovation. Drive portfolio rationalisation and prioritisation based on market potential, customer needs, and business impact. 
 2. Market Intelligence Opportunity Assessment Develop a strong understanding of the ophthalmology market, clinical workflows, customer segments, and evolving healthcare needs. Conduct structured market research, competitor benchmarking, technology assessment, and customer intelligence. Identify emerging technologies, unmet clinical needs, and market opportunities across domestic and international markets. Evaluate market size, commercial potential, customer willingness to adopt, and competitive dynamics. Convert market insights into actionable product strategies and business recommendations. 
 3. Product Roadmap Lifecycle Management Own product roadmaps, translating customer requirements and business priorities into clearly defined product plans. Work with Engineering, AI, Software, and Clinical teams to define product requirements, specifications, and development priorities. Drive product lifecycle management from concept, development, validation, and launch through upgrades and end-of-life decisions. Establish prioritisation frameworks balancing customer requirements, technical feasibility, regulatory considerations, timelines, and commercial value. Ensure products deliver on defined performance, usability, quality, and customer expectations. 
 4. Product Launch Go-to-Market Strategy Lead end-to-end product launches in collaboration with Sales, Marketing, Clinical, and Business teams. Develop go-to-market strategies, product positioning, pricing recommendations, and launch plans. Define target customer segments, use cases, differentiation, and product-specific value propositions. Build product messaging, sales enablement materials, demonstrations, and competitive positioning frameworks. Drive launch readiness across product, technical, clinical, regulatory, and commercial functions. Monitor post-launch performance and drive corrective actions to improve adoption and market traction. 
 5. Commercial Performance Product Adoption Own product-level business performance, including revenue contribution, market penetration, adoption, and portfolio growth. Partner with Sales and Business teams to drive product adoption, utilisation, and customer engagement. Identify barriers to adoption and develop strategies to improve customer conversion and product utilisation. Monitor product profitability, pricing effectiveness, margins, and commercial performance. Translate field feedback and customer insights into product improvements and growth opportunities. Drive accountability for product-level business outcomes. 
 6. Customer, Clinical KOL Engagement Build strong relationships with ophthalmologists, optometrists, hospital groups, clinical experts, and Key Opinion Leaders. Understand clinical workflows and translate real-world challenges into product opportunities. Lead customer discovery, product validation, pilot programs, and early-adopter engagement. Establish clinical champions and reference sites to strengthen product credibility and market adoption. Ensure customer and clinical feedback continuously informs product strategy and development priorities. 
 7. Cross-Functional Leadership Drive alignment across Engineering, AI, Software, Clinical, Regulatory, Quality, Sales, and Marketing teams. Act as the central owner connecting market requirements, product development, and commercial execution. Establish clear product governance, review mechanisms, development milestones, and performance dashboards. Resolve cross-functional priorities and ensure timely execution of product initiatives. Present product strategy, portfolio performance, market opportunities, and business recommendations to leadership. 
 8. Team Leadership Development Lead, mentor, and develop Product Managers and the product training / clinical application team. Establish clear ownership, accountability, and performance expectations across the product function. Build a high-performing product management team with strong market orientation, customer understanding, and execution discipline. Develop product management processes, frameworks, and capabilities to support Remidios growth. 
 What We Are Looking For 8-12+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Strategy, or Product Leadership within MedTech, ophthalmology, medical devices, or healthcare technology. Experience managing multiple products or a product portfolio, preferably in ophthalmic diagnostic or surgical devices. Strong understanding of ophthalmology, including clinical workflows, diagnostic technologies, imaging systems, and healthcare ecosystems. Demonstrated experience in product lifecycle management, roadmap ownership, and new product development. Proven track record of taking products from concept to launch and driving market adoption. Strong exposure to market research, competitive intelligence, customer discovery, and opportunity assessment. Experience in pricing strategy, product positioning, go-to-market planning, and commercial performance management. Ability to work closely with Engineering, RD, AI, Software, Clinical, and Sales teams. Strong business acumen with the ability to connect product decisions to revenue, profitability, and business growth. Experience leading and developing product management teams. Excellent stakeholder management, communication, analytical, and decision-making capabilities. Willingness to travel extensively for customer engagement, market visits, product launches, and international business requirements.

The successful candidate will play a critical role in driving product vision and strategy, leveraging market insights to identify new opportunities, and ensuring optimal product performance to meet customer and market needs. This role involves close collaboration with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to drive innovation, deliver exceptional customer value, and achieve performance goals. Primary Responsibilities Product Strategy & Voice AI Innovation Define and execute the product vision, roadmap, and long-term strategy for Conversational AI and Voice Bot solutions. Identify opportunities to leverage Voice AI, Generative AI, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Speech Recognition, and Speech Analytics technologies to improve customer experiences and operational efficiency. Conduct market research and competitive analysis to stay current with advancements in voice automation, conversational AI, and customer engagement technologies. Voice Bot Product Lifecycle Management Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle of Voice Bot and Conversational AI products from ideation, business case development, implementation, enhancement, and retirement. Gather business requirements and translate them into product features, user stories, and technical specifications. Collaborate closely with engineering, UX, operations, data science, and business stakeholders to drive successful product delivery. Conversational AI & Generative AI Integration Partner with AI/ML teams to design, implement, and optimize voice bot capabilities including intent recognition, dialogue management, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and generative AI-powered conversations. Drive adoption of emerging Generative AI technologies to enhance self-service capabilities, customer engagement, and agent-assist solutions. Evaluate and implement AI-driven features that improve containment rates, customer satisfaction, and operational outcomes. Performance Monitoring & Analytics Define and monitor KPIs such as containment rate, task completion rate, call deflection, customer satisfaction (CSAT), intent accuracy, automation rates, and financial performance. Develop dashboards and reporting frameworks to measure product success and identify optimization opportunities. Leverage voice analytics, conversational analytics, and customer insights to continuously improve product performance. Customer Experience & Voice Journey Optimization Act as the voice of the customer by analyzing customer behavior, call drivers, user feedback, and interaction data. Design and optimize conversational journeys that deliver seamless customer experiences across voice and digital channels. Validate product features through user testing and ongoing feedback loops. Financial Ownership & Business Value Develop business cases, ROI models, cost-benefit analyses, and investment proposals for voice automation initiatives. Partner with business leaders to establish measurable outcomes and value realization plans. Stakeholder Management Build strong relationships with stakeholders across business, operations, technology, customer service, and external partners. Present product strategy, roadmap updates, performance metrics, risks, and opportunities to leadership teams. Act as a Voice AI product champion and advocate across the organization.

Strong understanding of Voice AI technologies, including: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) Natural Language Understanding (NLU) Natural Language Processing (NLP) Text-to-Speech (TTS) Speech Analytics Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI Experience defining voice bot conversational flows, intent architecture, dialogue management, and customer journeys. Experience building business cases, ROI assessments, and value realization frameworks. Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills. Experience working in Agile product delivery environments. Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and leadership skills. Experience partnering with engineering and AI/ML teams to launch AI-driven customer-facing products. Preferred Qualifications Experience working with Contact Center technologies including IVR, CCaaS, Genesys, Five9, NICE, Avaya, or Cisco. Experience building both Voice Bots and Chatbots. Experience with Conversational Analytics and Speech Analytics platforms. Experience with Aha! and Rally. Experience within Optum, Healthcare, Behavioral Health, or Healthcare Contact Center domains. title: Cluster Manager /Senior Cluster Manager
description:
Job Purpose 
At Bajaj Finance, we help millions of people across India manage their money. People come to us when they want to buy a new phone on EMI, when they need a personal loan for a wedding, when they want to buy insurance, or when they want to grow their savings in a Fixed Deposit. Because we have so many customers, we get thousands of questions every single day. Customers want to know their account balance. They want to change the date their EMI gets deducted. They want to know the fees for closing a loan early.
In the past, to get these answers, a customer had to wait on hold to talk to a call center agent, or they had to tap through ten different screens on our mobile app. We want to change that. We want to make it as easy as sending a text message to a friend.
We are building a massive, highly intelligent AI (Artificial Intelligence) platform. Think of it like a super-smart chat assistant built right into the Bajaj Finance app. We want our customers to be able to just type out their problems in plain English, Hindi, or other languages, and have the AI fix the problem instantly. If a customer types, "Hey, I need to pause my loan payment this month," the AI should understand them, check their account, and do the work in seconds.
Building this is incredibly hard. It is not just a simple robot that gives canned answers. It is a smart system that has to understand human language, connect to our deep banking systems, and follow strict financial rules. Duties and Responsibilities 
Your Daily Work: The 9 Core Areas
Your job will be very hands-on. You will not just be sitting in long meetings talking about big ideas. You will be doing the real, detailed work to make this AI smart. Here are the nine specific areas you will be working on every day:
1. FPR (Future Press Release)
Before a single line of computer code is written, you have to know what your end goal is. We do this by writing a Future Press Release, or FPR.
A press release is a news article that a company puts out when they launch a cool new product. But here, you will write this news article before we even start building. You will write it as if the product is already finished and launched to the public. You will write a catchy headline like: "Bajaj Finance Launches AI That Solves Loan Issues in 10 Seconds." You will write quotes from pretend customers talking about how much they love the feature. You will explain exactly what problem the feature solves in simple, everyday language.
Why do we do thisBecause it keeps everyone focused. If the news article sounds boring or confusing, it means your idea is probably boring or confusing. Once you write a great FPR, you show it to the engineers and your bosses. When everyone reads it and says, "Wow, this sounds amazing, let's build it!"-that document becomes your team's guide.
2. FAQ (Frequently Asked Questions)
Along with your news article, you will write a massive list of Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ). But these are not just the normal questions a customer might ask. These are questions that anyone involved might ask.
You have to put yourself in the shoes of a confused customer. What will they ask"Is my bank data safe with this AI robot" You write the answer. You have to think like our call center agents. "Will this AI do my job wrong and make the customer angry" You write the answer. You have to think like our company lawyers. "Does this AI follow the Reserve Bank of India rules" You write the answer.
The goal of this FAQ is to force you to find all the problems and risks before the engineers start building. If you cannot answer a tough question in your FAQ document, it means your plan has a hole in it, and you need to fix your plan.
3. PPG (Product Program Guidelines)
Because Bajaj Finance deals with people's money, we have a lot of strict rules. We cannot just give a loan to anyone. We have to charge exact fees. We have to use exact interest rates. All of these strict rules are written down in company rulebooks called Product Program Guidelines, or PPG.
Every single product has a PPG. The personal loan has a PPG. The fixed deposit has a PPG. When we build the AI, the AI must follow the rules in the PPG perfectly. It cannot make a mistake. If the PPG says the late fee is 500 rupees, the AI cannot accidentally tell the customer the late fee is 400 rupees. That would cause a massive legal problem.|As a Product Manager, you will read these PPG rulebooks. You will pull out all the rules related to your project. You will work with the engineers to make sure these rules are permanently locked into the AI's brain. If the company changes a rule in the PPG next year, you are the person who makes sure the AI gets updated immediately.
4. Synthetic Testing
Once the engineers build a version of the AI, we have to test it. But we cannot let a broken, untested AI talk to real Bajaj Finance customers. That is too risky. If the AI is confused, a real customer might get bad advice about their loan.
So, we use something called Synthetic Testing. "Synthetic" just means fake or made-up. You will help create thousands of fake conversations to test the AI safely. You will create fake customer profiles. For example, you make a fake customer named Rahul who has a home loan. You will type to the AI pretending to be Rahul. You will ask, "Can I pay off my whole loan today" and see what the AI says.
Does the AI say yesDoes it calculate the early payment fee correctlyWhat if you pretend to be a customer who types with terrible spellingWhat if you type in a mix of Hindi and EnglishWhat if you pretend to be very angryDoes the AI still understand and stay politeYou will run hundreds of these fake tests. When the AI fails, you write down why it failed, take that information back to the engineers, and tell them what to fix. You keep doing this until the AI passes every fake test perfectly.
5. LLM Parameters (What We Send to the AI Brain)
The core brain of our AI is called a Large Language Model (LLM). Think of the LLM like an incredibly smart person sitting in a dark room. This person knows how to speak perfectly, but they have no idea who they are talking to.
If a customer types, "What is my balance", the smart person in the dark room has no idea whose balance to check. So, we have to send the LLM a package of extra information along with the customer's question. We call this setting the LLM Parameters.
As the Product Manager, you will decide exactly what information goes into that package. When the customer asks about their balance, you will tell our computer systems: "Before you let the AI answer, grab the customer's name, grab their last three payments, and grab their current loan amount. Send all of that to the AI."
You also have to send strict instructions. You will tell the AI, "You are a helpful assistant for Bajaj Finance. Always be polite. Do not guess numbers. Only use the numbers I just sent you." If you send the AI too much information, it gets confused and it costs the company too much money to process. If you send too little information, the AI gives a stupid answer. Your job is to find the perfect balance of what data to send the AI every time a customer speaks.
6. Visualisations
Chatting with an AI should not just be reading massive blocks of text. Nobody wants to read a giant paragraph of words on their small phone screen.|Sometimes, the best way to answer a customer is by showing them a picture, a chart, or a button. We call these Visualisations.
Let's say a customer asks, "How much of my loan have I paid off" The AI could write a long, boring sentence with a bunch of numbers. But it is much better if the AI shows a nice, clean pie chart on the screen. Half the pie is green for the money paid, and half is grey for the money left. The customer understands it instantly.
Or, if the AI needs the customer to pick a date, it shouldn't make the customer type "October 15th." It should pop up a small calendar on the screen so the customer can just tap the day. You will decide when to use text and when to use these visual tools. You will work with our designers to sketch out how these charts and buttons should look so the chat is beautiful and easy to use.
7. Product Switching
Imagine you are talking to a human salesman at a store. You ask about buying a TV. Then, suddenly, you change your mind and ask about buying a fridge. The human easily switches the topic to the fridge.Computers are not naturally good at this. If the computer is programmed to talk to you about a TV, and you ask about a fridge, the computer will get totally confused. It might say, "Error, I do not understand."
At Bajaj Finance, we have dozens of products. A customer might start a chat asking about their EMI shopping card. But halfway through the chat, they might say, "By the way, I also want to open a Fixed Deposit." The AI needs to smoothly switch from talking about the shopping card to talking about the Fixed Deposit without breaking or crashing.
We call this Product Switching. You will write the rules for how the AI handles these sudden changes in conversation. You will plan out how the AI remembers what the customer was talking about first, just in case the customer wants to go back to the original topic later.|8. Conversation Flows
A normal conversation flows naturally. But computers need a map. They need to be told exactly how a conversation should go, step by step. You will create these maps, which we call Conversation Flows.
You will literally use a software tool to draw boxes and arrows on your screen.
 Box 1: The AI says, "Hello, how can I help" -> Arrow points to Box 2.
 Box 2: The customer says, "I want to see my statement." -> Arrow points to Box 3.
 Box 3: The system checks if the customer's phone number is verified.
o If Yes -> Arrow points to Box 4.
o If No -> Arrow points to Box 5.
 Box 4: Show the statement on the screen.
 Box 5: Ask the customer to type in a one-time password (OTP).
You have to map out every single path the conversation could possibly take. You have to think of all the "what ifs." What if the customer types the wrong passwordWhat if the customer stops replying and walks away from their phoneWhat if the internet crashesYou must draw a box and an arrow for every single situation. These flowcharts become the actual instruction manual for the engineers. They look at your map and write the code to make it happen exactly as you drew it. Required Qualifications and Experience 
The Background You Need (Education Experience)
Because this job requires you to build highly complex computer systems, we are very strict about the background you need to have. We are looking for people who meet these exact requirements:
1. Your Education (The Degree and the College)
You must have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical computer field.
You must have graduated from a Tier 1 Engineering College. This means premier institutes like the IITs (Indian Institutes of Technology), NITs (National Institutes of Technology), or top-level Regional Engineering Colleges.
It is because the AI technology we are building is extremely complicated. You will be working side-by-side with some of the smartest software engineers in the country. You need to know how software is actually built. You need to understand coding logic, databases, and how computer servers talk to each other. Top engineering colleges train you to handle these tough, highly technical problems. If you do not have this strong computer science foundation, you will not be able to keep up with the engineering teams.
If you also have a Master's degree, that is great! We love to see it. But if you do not have a Master's degree, that is perfectly fine. It is not required. The Bachelor's degree from a Tier 1 college is what matters the most.
2. Your Work Experience (2 to 3 Years in NLP/AI)
You cannot be fresh out of college for this job. You must have at least 2 to 3 years of actual, hands-on work experience.
More importantly, this experience must be in a very specific area. You must have worked on NLP platforms. It is the specific technology that teaches computers how to read, understand, and write human language.
You must have spent the last few years of your career actually building chatbots, voice assistants, or smart AI text tools. You cannot just be someone who managed a normal website or a standard mobile app.

title: Senior Laravel PHP Engineer
description:
Job Summary 
 We are looking for a Senior Laravel PHP Engineer who will play a key role in building, scaling, and optimising CIMETs Comparison-as-a-Service (CaaS) platform. The role is responsible for developing high-performance backend services, designing scalable microservices architecture, optimising databases, and delivering reliable software solutions that support CIMETs product growth. The position works closely with Engineering, Product, DevOps, QA, and business stakeholders to build secure, scalable, and maintainable applications 
 
 Job Details 
 Position Title Senior Laravel PHP Engineer Work Location Jaipur/Gurugram Job Type Full Time Legal Entity Vconnex Pvt Ltd Qualifications Any Graduations (BCA, MCA, Btech) Experience Required 7-10 years 
 
 Organizational Context 
 Company Name - CIMET 
 
 Purpose of the Position 
 
 Key Accountabilities 
 
 Backend Development Architecture 
 Architect, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Laravel (PHP 8+). Build and integrate microservices to improve modularity, scalability, and performance. Develop and optimise RESTful APIs and GraphQL services. Ensure application reliability, maintainability, and security. 
 
 Database Engineering 
 Design and optimise MySQL database schemas for scalability and performance. Implement caching solutions using Redis and Memcached. Drive query optimisation and database performance tuning initiatives. 
 
 System Architecture Infrastructure 
 Develop event-driven and asynchronous processing systems. Work with messaging technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, and SQS. Collaborate on AWS-based cloud deployments using containerised environments including Docker and Kubernetes. 
 
 Quality Engineering Excellence 
 Maintain clean coding standards and software engineering best practices. Build and enhance CI/CD pipelines and automated testing frameworks. Ensure application security and code quality through reviews and testing. Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews and technical guidance. 
 
 Collaboration Stakeholder Management 
 Work closely with Product Managers, DevOps Engineers, QA teams, and Engineering Leadership. Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning. Support Agile/Scrum delivery practices and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 
 Your Skills and Experience 
 
 Experience 
 7+ years of backend development experience using PHP. Minimum 3+ years of production experience with Laravel. 2+ years of experience designing and deploying microservices architectures. Proven track record of working on scalable, high-traffic applications. 
 
 Technical Skills 
 Strong expertise in Laravel (PHP 8+) and microservices-based development. Deep understanding of MySQL, indexing, query optimisation, and database performance tuning. Hands-on experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs and GraphQL services. Working knowledge of Node.js services and integrations. Experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and Jenkins. Good understanding of SOLID principles, design patterns, and clean architecture. 
 
 Cloud Infrastructure 
 Hands-on experience with AWS services such as ECS, EKS, S3, RDS, and Lambda. Experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Understanding of monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, ELK, and New Relic. 
 
 AI Modern Development Practices 
 Experience using AI-assisted coding tools such as Cursor AI, Claude Code, or GitHub Copilot. Ability to leverage AI for code generation, debugging, refactoring, and documentation. Understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, and AI-powered development workflows. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with MongoDB or DynamoDB. Familiarity with Kafka, RabbitMQ, or SQS. Knowledge of Vue.js or React for cross-functional collaboration. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. 
 
 Challenges of the Position 
 Rapid Growth: CIMET will grow massively over the next 2 years, we need to build and onboard a team of high-performing people to enable the planned growth to reach fruition. Systems: CIMET is in the growth phase of the expansion, where systems, processes and policies are being developed and implemented. This means there will be constant changes occurring and you will need to be agile in your approach to changing business priorities.

title: Senior SAP Crystal Reports Consultant
description:
We are hiring a Senior SAP Crystal Reports Consultant for a large-scale Reporting Transformation project with a leading US-based banking client. The candidate will lead the technical assessment of a large legacy SAP Crystal Reports environment, including automated metadata extraction, report inventory, complexity assessment, reverse engineering of report logic, and migration recommendations. 
 The role requires deep hands-on expertise in SAP Crystal Reports, SAP BusinessObjects, SQL, and scripting, along with exposure to modern BI and data platforms such as Snowflake and Power BI. 
 Key Responsibilities Lead technical discovery and assessment of the legacy SAP Crystal Reports portfolio. Automate report metadata extraction using CMS Query Builder, Auditing Database, BI Platform SDK, REST APIs, and scripting. Create and maintain a comprehensive inventory of reports, including ownership, schedules, data sources, destinations, usage, and execution history. Reverse-engineer complex Crystal Reports, including SQL queries, formulas, subreports, parameters, stored procedures, and business logic. Perform report rationalization by identifying duplicate, obsolete, unused, and failing reports. Define report complexity ratings based on data sources, formulas, subreports, parameters, and distribution requirements. Map legacy reporting data sources to the target Snowflake data platform. Recommend future-state solutions such as Power BI dashboards, paginated reports, Alteryx workflows, Power Automate, or governed data products. Provide migration estimates, technical dependencies, and implementation recommendations. Maintain and enhance existing Crystal Reports wherever required. Guide and mentor junior SAP Crystal Developers. Work closely with Business Analysts, Project Managers, and client stakeholders. Maintain technical documentation, data lineage, and assessment deliverables. 
 Mandatory Technical Skills SAP Crystal Reports: 2013 / 2016 / 2020 or later. SAP BusinessObjects BI Platform / Crystal Server: CMC, scheduling, publications, instances, and report distribution. Metadata Extraction: CMS Query Builder, Auditing Database, BI Platform SDK, RESTful Web Services. SQL: Advanced SQL, complex joins, stored procedures, query optimization, and performance analysis. Crystal Reports Development: Formulas, subreports, parameters, command objects, and report logic. Scripting: Python or PowerShell for automation and metadata extraction. Report Inventory, Rationalization, Migration, and Modernization. 
 Good to Have Skills Power BI / Power BI Paginated Reports. SSRS and modern BI reporting tools. Snowflake, Alteryx, and Power Automate. Data Warehousing and Dimensional Modeling. Data Governance and Data Lineage. Banking / Financial Services domain experience. Azure DevOps, JIRA, and Confluence. SAP BusinessObjects / Power BI / SnowPro certifications. 
 Experience & Qualifications 10+ years of hands-on experience in SAP Crystal Reports development, administration, and consulting. Strong experience with SAP BusinessObjects BI Platform and Crystal Server. Proven experience in large-scale report assessment, rationalization, migration, or upgrade initiatives. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills. Ability to independently reverse-engineer complex legacy reports and translate technical findings into business-friendly documentation. 
 Ideal Candidate Profile A seasoned SAP Crystal Reports specialist with strong technical and analytical expertise, capable of automating metadata extraction, assessing large reporting portfolios, reverse-engineering complex report logic, and recommending modernization strategies. 
 The candidate should be comfortable working directly with US-based clients, mentoring junior developers, and collaborating with business and project management teams.

description:
Job Description About Flow by ServiceNow Flow is a product and a new business unit in ServiceNow staffed by a team of 0-1 builders. We re creating Flow, an AI-native conversational experience for natural language automation and enterprise service management. Flow is built on a new tech stack with new ways of working. We challenge established practices and are defining a new product and GTM playbook for ServiceNow. Flow puts what we build in front of the largest possible audience. You ll have real ownership of the work, the freedom to move fast, and the resources of a global technology leader behind you. If you have a point of view on building and want to start from the beginning again, we want to talk to you, wherever you are. Plenty of people can ship an AI prototype this year. Few get to build a product that runs enterprise work at global scale. Join us. Job Description We are hiring a hands-on Senior Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer who serves as the technical champion for customers, guiding them from their first demo and trial to long-term success with Flow. You will demonstrate the product, answer technical questions, set up and enable Flow, and help customers build automations and integrations through AI-assisted, natural-language development. You will solve problems the product does not yet handle and translate customer needs into clear requirements that help product managers prioritize what to build next. The role combines technical implementation, customer success, and support. Ready to be the person who turns we re stuck into we re live We re looking for a hybrid problem-solver who helps trial customers and enterprise IT teams unlock the full power of Flow. You will own complex customer problems end to end, and your work will shape what Flow does next. What You Will Do Technical Solutions Work with customer IT and security teams to configure SSO and integrations with tools such as Okta, Microsoft Teams, Slack, and ServiceNow. Build, test, and launch automations with Flow s natural-language builder, connecting to tools such as Jira, Workday, Zoom, Microsoft 365, and ServiceNow. Connect document sources such as SharePoint, Google Drive, Box, Notion, and the ServiceNow knowledge base so the AI returns accurate, sourced answers. Solve complex customer requirements outside the standard product, document effective workarounds, and turn customer learnings into clear product requirements that you help refine and shepherd through delivery. Build proof-of-concept solutions and workflows for strategic evaluations. Customer Success and Adoption Guide new customers through a structured onboarding path, setting up and enabling Flow in a few hours so they can reach a live production deployment in one day. Monitor usage, conversation allowances, and automation results in Flow analytics, using the data to demonstrate value and identify new automation opportunities. Identify opportunities to expand Flow from an initial use case into a broader self-service service desk. Translate customer pain points and requests into clear product requirements, then partner with product and engineering to refine and shepherd them through delivery. Support and Reliability Own first-line triage for trial and enterprise customers, answering technical questions and escalating issues when deeper product or engineering support is needed. Be the go-to person when customers encounter API timeouts, sync errors, payment-related questions, or failed automations, and drive issues from initial diagnosis through resolution. Reproduce bugs, isolate root causes, and work directly with core engineers to resolve them. Monitor health, audit, and activity logs to identify outages or issues that prevent customers from using Flow fully. Use Flow audit and activity logs to diagnose complex customer issues, confirm what happened, and drive the issue to resolution. Qualifications 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role, such as forward deployed, solutions, or implementation engineering, in enterprise software. Hands-on experience with REST APIs, scripting, automations, and webhooks, with comfort testing them using tools such as Postman or cURL. Working knowledge of single sign-on and identity providers, including SAML, OAuth, Okta, and Entra ID. Experience with enterprise service management or collaboration tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, Slack, or Microsoft Teams. Familiarity with AI and workflow automation, including prompt design and how AI systems retrieve information from documents. Communicate clearly with stakeholders from IT directors to system administrators and security engineers. See how Flow fits into a customer s broader IT and operations strategy and ServiceNow s plans. Demonstrated ability to take ownership of customer outcomes while partnering effectively across product, engineering, support, and customer teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience with service desk offerings. Experience with AI-native or cloud-native enterprise products. Background in product-led growth or consumption-priced software. Experience building an onboarding or implementation motion from scratch; startup experience is helpful but not required.

Ensure effective utilization of manpower, machinery, materials, and equipment. Identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality. D. Quality Control Ensure construction activities comply with approved drawings, specifications, and quality standards. Implement quality assurance and quality control procedures. description:
Job Category: Project Management; Engineering Location: Gurugram, Haryana, India Summary The Engagement Manager is responsible for the successful delivery of the engagement's objectives which includes engagement team leadership and quality completion of the client's requirements and deliverables in accordance with the approved plans in alignment with the client agreement. Responsibilities As the successful candidate, you will: The Engagement Manager is responsible for delivery of the engagement post-award, which includes the day-to-day management of the plans, processes, tools, and responsibilities associated with delivering the engagement to the client's and Hatch's defined expectations. This is achieved by being involved in the pursuit phase as early as practical. Establishing appropriate and approved management plans. Managing the engagement delivery in accordance with the approved management plans. Leading the delivery team and providing support, guidance and coaching as required. Ensuring the completion of engagement reviews and monthly reporting in support of the successful delivery of the engagement for the client and Hatch. This position description should be read in conjunction with the Project Management Discipline Guide, which provides the overall context for the Engagement Manager's accountabilities and responsibilities. Pursuit Stage During each phase of the Engagement Lifecycle from the time the Engagement Manager is appointed, the responsibilities of the role include: Winning Work Phase Winning Work Phase Support the winning work efforts or proposal process as required. Participate in Prime Contract discussions and negotiations as required. Initiation and Transition Phase Assist the Delivery Sponsor in completing the engagement transition from the Pursuit Team to the Delivery Team. Open the engagement in iPas PM with the Business Sponsor's agreement. Establish appropriate systems including appropriate people, processes and tools are in place to manage the engagement. Establish original baselines and delivery, functional and performance requirements, including identifying risks, performance metrics and KPIs to achieve the client and Hatch standards. title: Staff Software Development Engineer - Java/Go + Distributed Systems
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world s largest in-line cloud security platform. We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era Join us at Zscaler. Role We are looking for a Staff Software Development Engineer to join our team. This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore/Hyderabad, reporting to the Senior Manager of Software Engineering. You will join the Engineering team that built the world s largest cloud security platform from the ground up. As a leader in our multitenant architecture, you will bring your vision and passion to help organizations worldwide harness speed and agility with a cloud-first strategy. What you ll do (Role Expectations) Understand how to build and operate high scale systems Provide service and product wide architectural guidance, and drive impactful technical decisions Establish and enforce best practices for coding, testing, observability, and CI/CD pipelines to maintain high-quality, production-ready services Drive cross-team collaboration and lead initiatives in performance optimization, reliability improvements, and adoption of new technologies/tools to accelerate feature velocity Who You Are (Success Profile) You thrive in ambiguity. Youre comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful. You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution. You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact. You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback-knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust. You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose. What We re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications) Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain and experience with agentic AI systems and orchestration workflows 5+ years of experience in Java/Go coding in a highly distributed and enterprise-scale environment Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure services on AWS or Azure Strong experience with distributed systems and microservices architecture Strong database knowledge of SQL constructs and data modeling Strong experience with Identity governance and administration, Access Management What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications) Experience leveraging AI coding assistants, automated code review tooling, or LLM-assisted development workflows to optimize software architecture and accelerate delivery cycles Experience building reliable data tiers using Postgres, Redis, Terraform, Ansible, graph databases like Neo4j or AWS Neptune, and developing GraphQL APIs Deep knowledge of identity and access management systems (Okta, SAML, OAuth), test automation, Python programming, and designing fault-tolerant distributed systems for networking or cloud security products #LI-Hybrid #LI-NT1 At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. description:
Job Title: Embedded Hardware / Firmware Engineer Industrial Instruments & Sensor Interfaces Company: LABTECH ELECTRONICS PRIVATE LIMITED
 Location: Gerugambakkam, Chennai
 Employment: Full-time, on-site
 Experience: 3–8 years; senior candidates with complete product development experience will also be considered
 Qualification: B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech in Electronics, Electronics & Communication, Instrumentation, Embedded Systems, or a related discipline
 Compensation: Based on relevant experience and demonstrated technical capability About Labtech Labtech Electronics Private Limited manufactures process instruments and provides industrial instrumentation, automation, and remote monitoring solutions. Our product portfolio includes flow meters, liquid and gas analysers, level instruments, transmitters, sensor interfaces, and industrial IoT products. We are expanding our R&D team to develop indigenous hardware and firmware, complete ongoing product designs, and establish production-ready products with in-house design ownership. Role Overview We seek hands-on engineers who can develop reliable industrial electronic products from requirements and circuit design through embedded firmware, calibration, validation, and manufacturing handover. Openings are available for hardware-focused and firmware-focused engineers. Candidates with strong capabilities in both disciplines are particularly welcome. Key Responsibilities Review existing designs, identify technical gaps, and complete hardware and firmware development. Translate product specifications into practical electronic architectures and development plans. Develop sensor interface boards, signal-conditioning circuits, transmitter electronics, and communication modules. Integrate sensors for flow, pressure, temperature, level, and liquid/gas analysis, depending on the assigned product. Develop measurement, filtering, linearisation, temperature compensation, calibration, diagnostics, and fault-handling functions. Build and debug prototypes; verify measurement accuracy, repeatability, stability, and communication performance. Address industrial operating conditions, including electrical noise, power disturbances, temperature variation, and field wiring faults. Support component selection, alternate sourcing, BOM optimisation, and design for manufacturing and testing. Prepare and maintain design files, source code, test procedures, calibration procedures, and production documentation. Work with production, application, and service teams to resolve field issues and improve product reliability. Maintain company-controlled repositories and complete technical handover for every assigned design. Embedded Hardware Engineer – Required Skills Hands-on experience in analog, digital, and mixed-signal circuit design and antennas. Precision signal conditioning using operational amplifiers, instrumentation amplifiers, filters, ADCs, DACs, and voltage references. Experience with low-level sensor signals, grounding, shielding, isolation, and noise reduction. Design of 4–20 mA inputs/outputs, 0–10 V interfaces, pulse/frequency interfaces, and RS485 communication circuits. Microcontroller-based circuit design and PCB development using Altium Designer, KiCad, OrCAD, or equivalent tools. Power supply design, including DC–DC converters, LDOs, reverse-polarity protection, surge protection, and ESD protection. PCB layout practices for precision measurement, EMC performance, and industrial reliability. Board bring-up, soldering/rework, and debugging using oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analysers, and signal sources. Preparation of schematics, PCB manufacturing files, BOMs, and assembly/test instructions. Embedded Firmware Engineer – Required Skills Strong Embedded C programming and practical microcontroller debugging experience and monitor programming. Experience with STM32, Microchip PIC/dsPIC, TI MSP430/C2000, NXP, or comparable MCU platforms. Development of peripheral drivers using ADC, DAC, timers, interrupts, DMA, UART, SPI, and IC. Implementation and debugging of Modbus RTU and RS485 communication. Experience with bare-metal firmware and/or an RTOS such as FreeRTOS. Measurement processing, digital filtering, calibration routines, engineering-unit conversion, and non-volatile parameter storage. Watchdog handling, fault recovery, diagnostics, and reliable startup behaviour. Bootloaders, firmware upgrades, and version control using Git. Ability to write structured, maintainable code and document firmware architecture and interfaces. Preferred Experience Experience in one or more of the following will be an advantage: Industrial transmitters, process instruments, smart sensors, or precision measurement equipment. Two-wire, loop-powered 4–20 mA transmitters and HART integration. RTD, thermocouple, bridge/mV, pulse, frequency, or high-impedance electrochemical sensor interfaces. pH/ORP, conductivity, dissolved oxygen, gas sensing, or optical analyser electronics. Electromagnetic, ultrasonic, thermal mass, vortex, or differential-pressure flow measurement. Ethernet, CAN, Modbus TCP, MQTT, and industrial IoT connectivity. Low-power design, galvanic isolation, environmental testing, and EMC pre-compliance testing. Production calibration fixtures, automated functional testing, and pilot-batch support. Candidates are not expected to have experience in every sensor technology. Strong fundamentals and relevant product development experience are essential. Expected Deliverables Working prototypes meeting agreed functional and measurement requirements. Released schematics, PCB files, BOMs, and documented firmware source code. Calibration methods and validation reports. Production test procedures and manufacturing handover documents. Resolution of issues identified during pilot production and field trials. Candidate Profile We value engineers who demonstrate practical problem-solving, ownership, disciplined documentation, and the ability to complete designs. Applicants should be able to explain their personal contribution to at least one working embedded product. How to Apply Send your CV to career@labtech.co.in . Email subject: Application – Embedded Hardware Engineer / Embedded Firmware Engineer Please include your current location, relevant experience, current and expected CTC, notice period, and a brief description of two relevant projects. 1) AI Native Data Product Engineering (on Datasphere)

 Training foundation models from scratch (the emphasis is on building agentic apps and governed retrieval on enterprise data).

title: Embedded Hardware and Firmware Engineer - Industrial Instruments
description:
Job Title: Embedded Hardware / Firmware Engineer Industrial Instruments & Sensor Interfaces Company: LABTECH ELECTRONICS PRIVATE LIMITED
 Location: Gerugambakkam, Chennai
 Employment: Full-time, on-site
 Experience: 3–8 years; senior candidates with complete product development experience will also be considered
 Qualification: B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech in Electronics, Electronics & Communication, Instrumentation, Embedded Systems, or a related discipline
 Compensation: Based on relevant experience and demonstrated technical capability About Labtech Labtech Electronics Private Limited manufactures process instruments and provides industrial instrumentation, automation, and remote monitoring solutions. Our product portfolio includes flow meters, liquid and gas analysers, level instruments, transmitters, sensor interfaces, and industrial IoT products. We are expanding our R&D team to develop indigenous hardware and firmware, complete ongoing product designs, and establish production-ready products with in-house design ownership. Role Overview We seek hands-on engineers who can develop reliable industrial electronic products from requirements and circuit design through embedded firmware, calibration, validation, and manufacturing handover. Openings are available for hardware-focused and firmware-focused engineers. Candidates with strong capabilities in both disciplines are particularly welcome. Key Responsibilities Review existing designs, identify technical gaps, and complete hardware and firmware development. Translate product specifications into practical electronic architectures and development plans. Develop sensor interface boards, signal-conditioning circuits, transmitter electronics, and communication modules. Integrate sensors for flow, pressure, temperature, level, and liquid/gas analysis, depending on the assigned product. Develop measurement, filtering, linearisation, temperature compensation, calibration, diagnostics, and fault-handling functions. Build and debug prototypes; verify measurement accuracy, repeatability, stability, and communication performance. Address industrial operating conditions, including electrical noise, power disturbances, temperature variation, and field wiring faults. Support component selection, alternate sourcing, BOM optimisation, and design for manufacturing and testing. Prepare and maintain design files, source code, test procedures, calibration procedures, and production documentation. Work with production, application, and service teams to resolve field issues and improve product reliability. Maintain company-controlled repositories and complete technical handover for every assigned design. Embedded Hardware Engineer – Required Skills Hands-on experience in analog, digital, and mixed-signal circuit design and antennas. Precision signal conditioning using operational amplifiers, instrumentation amplifiers, filters, ADCs, DACs, and voltage references. Experience with low-level sensor signals, grounding, shielding, isolation, and noise reduction. Design of 4–20 mA inputs/outputs, 0–10 V interfaces, pulse/frequency interfaces, and RS485 communication circuits. Microcontroller-based circuit design and PCB development using Altium Designer, KiCad, OrCAD, or equivalent tools. Power supply design, including DC–DC converters, LDOs, reverse-polarity protection, surge protection, and ESD protection. PCB layout practices for precision measurement, EMC performance, and industrial reliability. Board bring-up, soldering/rework, and debugging using oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analysers, and signal sources. Preparation of schematics, PCB manufacturing files, BOMs, and assembly/test instructions. Embedded Firmware Engineer – Required Skills Strong Embedded C programming and practical microcontroller debugging experience and monitor programming. Experience with STM32, Microchip PIC/dsPIC, TI MSP430/C2000, NXP, or comparable MCU platforms. Development of peripheral drivers using ADC, DAC, timers, interrupts, DMA, UART, SPI, and IC. Implementation and debugging of Modbus RTU and RS485 communication. Experience with bare-metal firmware and/or an RTOS such as FreeRTOS. Measurement processing, digital filtering, calibration routines, engineering-unit conversion, and non-volatile parameter storage. Watchdog handling, fault recovery, diagnostics, and reliable startup behaviour. Bootloaders, firmware upgrades, and version control using Git. Ability to write structured, maintainable code and document firmware architecture and interfaces. Preferred Experience Experience in one or more of the following will be an advantage: Industrial transmitters, process instruments, smart sensors, or precision measurement equipment. Two-wire, loop-powered 4–20 mA transmitters and HART integration. RTD, thermocouple, bridge/mV, pulse, frequency, or high-impedance electrochemical sensor interfaces. pH/ORP, conductivity, dissolved oxygen, gas sensing, or optical analyser electronics. Electromagnetic, ultrasonic, thermal mass, vortex, or differential-pressure flow measurement. Ethernet, CAN, Modbus TCP, MQTT, and industrial IoT connectivity. Low-power design, galvanic isolation, environmental testing, and EMC pre-compliance testing. Production calibration fixtures, automated functional testing, and pilot-batch support. Candidates are not expected to have experience in every sensor technology. Strong fundamentals and relevant product development experience are essential. Expected Deliverables Working prototypes meeting agreed functional and measurement requirements. Released schematics, PCB files, BOMs, and documented firmware source code. Calibration methods and validation reports. Production test procedures and manufacturing handover documents. Resolution of issues identified during pilot production and field trials. Candidate Profile We value engineers who demonstrate practical problem-solving, ownership, disciplined documentation, and the ability to complete designs. Applicants should be able to explain their personal contribution to at least one working embedded product. How to Apply Send your CV to career@labtech.co.in . Email subject: Application – Embedded Hardware Engineer / Embedded Firmware Engineer Please include your current location, relevant experience, current and expected CTC, notice period, and a brief description of two relevant projects. Describe only information you are authorised to share. Naukri Key Skills:

title: Senior SOC Verification Engineer
description:
Job Summary 
 We are looking for an experienced SoC Verification Engineer with strong expertise in functional verification of complex System-on-Chip (SoC) designs. 
 The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in SystemVerilog, UVM, constrained-random verification, functional coverage, and verification of complex IPs and SoC subsystems. 
 The candidate will be responsible for developing verification environments, creating test plans, executing simulation-based verification, debugging functional issues, and ensuring comprehensive verification coverage. The role involves close collaboration with RTL design, IP verification, architecture, and integration teams to deliver high-quality silicon designs. 

 Key Responsibilities 
 Develop and execute verification plans for complex SoC designs and subsystems. Develop and maintain SystemVerilog/UVM-based verification environments and testbenches. Create directed and constrained-random test scenarios to validate functional requirements. Perform block-level, subsystem-level, and SoC-level functional verification. Verify complex IP integrations and interactions between different SoC components. Develop UVM agents, drivers, monitors, sequences, scoreboards, and verification components. Implement functional coverage models and drive coverage closure. Develop and maintain SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) to validate design protocols and functional behaviour. Debug simulation failures, RTL mismatches, and complex integration issues. Perform regression testing and analyse simulation results to identify functional defects. Verify standard interfaces and protocols such as AMBA AXI, AHB, APB, and other relevant bus protocols. Work on clock, reset, interrupt, power-management, and memory subsystem verification. Collaborate with RTL designers to resolve design issues and ensure functional correctness. Support gate-level simulation, low-power verification, and post-silicon debug activities wherever required. Maintain verification documentation, test plans, coverage reports, and regression results. 
 Mandatory Technical Skills 
 6+ years of experience in ASIC / SoC Design Verification. Strong hands-on experience in SystemVerilog and UVM-based verification. Good understanding of digital design concepts, RTL architecture, and SoC design fundamentals. Experience developing UVM testbenches and reusable verification components. Strong knowledge of constrained-random verification methodologies. Experience with functional coverage, code coverage, and coverage closure. Hands-on experience with SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA). Experience verifying complex IPs, subsystems, and SoC-level integrations. Good understanding of AMBA protocols, particularly AXI, AHB, and APB. Strong debugging skills using simulation waveforms and verification tools. Experience with industry-standard simulation tools such as:
 Synopsys VCS Cadence Xcelium Siemens Questa Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python, Perl, or Tcl. Preferred Skills Experience with SoC architecture and integration verification. Exposure to multi-core processors, interconnects, memory controllers, DMA, and interrupt controllers. Knowledge of cache coherency protocols and memory subsystem verification. Experience with low-power verification methodologies, including UPF. Understanding of Clock Domain Crossing (CDC) and Reset Domain Crossing (RDC) verification. Exposure to formal verification and property checking. Experience with gate-level simulation and timing-aware verification. Knowledge of PCIe, USB, Ethernet, DDR, I2C, SPI, or other high-speed and peripheral interfaces. Exposure to emulation platforms and FPGA prototyping. Understanding of performance verification, stress testing, and corner-case testing. Experience with post-silicon validation and silicon bring-up is an added advantage. Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, VLSI, or a related discipline. Minimum 6+ years of relevant experience in SoC / ASIC Design Verification. Strong hands-on experience in SystemVerilog and UVM. Ability to independently own verification activities and work with cross-functional engineering teams. Key Competencies Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Excellent debugging and root-cause analysis skills. Ability to understand complex SoC architectures and identify functional corner cases. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Ability to manage verification milestones and deliver quality results within project timelines.

title: Power and Cooling Service Engineer
description:
Role & responsibilities Lenovos Solutions and Services Group (SSG) is seeking a skilled and motivated Power and Cooling (PNC) Service Engineer to support the installation, commissioning, and maintenance of advanced cooling systems in high-performance data centers. This role is essential to ensuring the successful deployment of direct liquid cooling (DLC), chilled water, and other secondary cooling infrastructure that supports mission-critical server environments. The ideal candidate will have a mechanical and technical background, experience with industrial cooling systems, and a commitment to quality and safety. This position involves frequent travel to customer sites and close collaboration with engineering, project management, and service delivery teams. 
 Responsibilities:

 * Lead full project lifecycle for data center power and cooling deployments
* Manage installation and commissioning of liquid cooling systems, CDUs, and liquid-cooled servers
* Manage the maintenance and water-testing schedule, results, and remediation actions for water quality at all global installations
* Coordinate site readiness, logistics, and deployment sequencing
* Provide technical oversight across power, HVAC, and thermal systems
* Manage stakeholders, including customers, vendors, and contractors
* Track project schedules, budgets, and KPIs
* Oversee testing, commissioning, and operational handoff
* Drive continuous improvement and adoption of new cooling technologies

Required Qualifications

* Install and configure cooling system components according to engineering drawings and specifications.
* Perform system checks, pressure testing, and leak detection to ensure operational readiness.
* Support water treatment setup and monitoring to maintain system health and compliance.
* Execute preventative maintenance tasks such as filter changes, flow validation, and sensor calibration.
* Document installation procedures, test results, and maintenance activities.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely and successful deployments.
* Provide on-site technical support and troubleshooting during and after system commissioning.
* Follow safety protocols and environmental guidelines during all field activities.

Qualifications:
* 2+ years of experience in industrial cooling systems, HVAC, or data center infrastructure deployment.
* Familiarity with chilled water systems, DLC, or other liquid-based cooling technologies.
* Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, P&IDs, and installation schematics.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

* A willingness to travel frequently and work in data center environments.
* OSHA 10/30 or similar safety certification is a plus.

Preferred Skills:

* Customer support background with exposure to technical infrastructure drawings

* Strong communication skills and ability to work independently or as part of a team.
